{{Top}}
{{Quote|For every insult, you will scream a dozen times.|Darth Vader, threatening Han Solo|<ref name="TESBrd">[[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' radio drama]]</ref>|audio=ForEveryInsult-ESBRadio.flac}}
[[File:Troture_TCG_Nash.png|thumb|right|300px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] tortures [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] as a means of luring [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]]]
Throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], any practice by which severe pain and/or suffering was inflicted on a being, whether physical or mental, was considered '''torture'''.<ref>Deduced from ''Star Wars'' literature where these acts are clearly identified asf torture, for example, ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', [[Dark Times 9|''Dark Times'' 9]], [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]], ''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]'', ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'', ''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]'', etc.</ref>

Torture was used for such purposes as obtaining from the subject or a third party information<ref>For example, from the subject: [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]; from a third party: ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Ties That Bind]]''</ref> or a confession,<ref name="Star Wars: Vader's Quest" /> or as punishment for an act an individual had or was suspected of having committed.<ref name="The Hutt Gambit">For example, ''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref> Other motives were simple revenge<ref name="Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel">For example, ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> or the sadistic gratification of the torturer.<ref name="ExDoom">For example, ''[[Boba Fett: Agent of Doom]]''</ref> Torture also served as a way of intimidating or coercing individuals,<ref name="Han Solo's Revenge">For example, ''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref> or for discriminatory reasons of any kind.<ref name="ExDoom" /> Occasionally, torture was the adverse byproduct of medical or scientific research, studies, or procedures, and usually occurred without the consent of the victim.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 8">For example, [[Knights of the Old Republic 8|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 8]]</ref> Torturous methods could be initiated at the directives of heads of state<ref>For example, ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Ties That Bind]]'' and [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O]] in the ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> or other individuals or groups.<ref>For example, ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', ''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref> Since [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] could sense the reactions of loved individuals, torture could be used as a means to manipulate them, even from a considerable distance.<ref name="SWEV">{{Film|V}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|There is never an excuse for cruelty towards a captive.|[[Kaye Galfridian]], [[Prince/Legends|princess]] of the peace-loving planet [[Artorias]]|<ref name="RESCUES3" />}}
Torture was widely considered as a gruesome and unethical practice by most cultures in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref>Obvious from information in stories like ''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]'' (novel), ''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]'', ''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]'' etc.</ref> Despotic governments and heads of states often coerced [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] into revealing sensitive information through the use of intimidation and torture,<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> and the known examples varied from a galactic level (the reigns of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="EGWT" /><ref name="RFT">''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]''</ref><ref name="Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game first edition">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]<ref name="LB">''[[Star Wars: Legacy: Broken]]''</ref>) to the [[Sector/Legends|sectorial]] (the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|New Sith Empire]]<ref name="ORR">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> and the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]<ref name="EGWT" />) to the [[Star system/Legends|system]]- or [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-wide, which included everything from royal houses (like [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Sarna (Queen)|Sarna's]] [[King/Legends|monarchy]] on [[Drogheda/Legends|Drogheda]]<ref name="Star Wars 1977 83">[[Star Wars (1977) 83|''Star Wars'' (1977) 83]]</ref> and the [[Doan Royal House]] of [[Doan]]<ref name="DBDE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>) to elites (like the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]],<ref name="TJDLS">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith]]''</ref> the [[Tundei]] of [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]]<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> and the [[Absolutes]] on [[New Apsolon/Legends|New Apsolon]]<ref name="TTTB">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Ties That Bind]]''</ref>) to single dictators like [[Craw|Dictator-Forever Craw]] of [[Targonn/Legends|Targonn]].<ref name="SWD:SoR3">[[Droids (1995) 7|''Droids'' (1995) 7]]</ref>

[[File:Mirith-torture.jpg|thumb|left|210px|New Republic Intelligence agent [[Mirith Sinn]] being tortured by Imperial Guard Carnor Jax's men]]
Torture was also utilized by gangsters and criminal organizations; one notable example was the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord [[Rokko]], whose invention and enjoyment of various forms of torture was the stuff of many a con being's nightmare.<ref name="JT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> To [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] like [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]],<ref name="Gambit">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref> [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]<ref name="SOS">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref> and [[Feskitt Bobb]],<ref name="I80">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> torture was a useful tool for locating their prey.

The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was founded on the principles of law and justice, and torture was against the bylaws of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="LJU">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]''</ref> Torture droids were also illegal by the laws of the Republic.<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> However, beyond the Republic's boundaries, there were [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with much lower moral codes, where sentients tortured other sentients for power or greed.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref>

After [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], a former [[Senator/Legends|senator]] from the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], assumed the position of galactic [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] approved his call for more freedom in the treatment of the enemies of the Empire ("in times such as these, extreme measures can be called for" - [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Imperial Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]]).<ref name="LJU" /> Under Imperial rule, there was intense demand for torture [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and torture equipment of all kinds,<ref name="EGWT" /> and torture droids were invented behind the curtain of Imperial secrecy.<ref name="SWCE" /> This was in strong contrast with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], who would never resort to either torture or interrogation droids.<ref name="RFT" />

After the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|fall of the Empire]], the resulting [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] took a firm stand against the use of torture,<ref name="EGWT" /> but apparently, some members of the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] would simply ignore this; certain members of the organization, like [[Heol Girdun]], would routinely resort to torture during interrogation sessions.<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> In addition, torture equipment and droids were still manufactured in secret, and were often used by criminals and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] worlds.<ref name="EGWT" /> Many remaining Imperials like [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]],<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Imperial Guard]] [[Carnor Jax]],<ref name="Crimson">''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire]]''</ref> [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Leonia Tavira]],<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Warrior Princess">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Warrior Princess]]''</ref> Admiral [[Ysanne Isard]],<ref name="XWKT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref> [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], and the sadistic scientist [[Leonis Murthé]]<ref name="BFAD">''[[Boba Fett: Agent of Doom]]''</ref> also perpetuated Palpatine's Imperial tradition.

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the central government of the New Republic was unable to coordinate an effective response to the invasion. The result was that the government was reorganized into the much more centralized [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] ("The Galactic Alliance"). This new government was strong enough to drive back the Vong, but would also take many political and military decisions away from individual [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. [[40 ABY/Legends|Five years]] into the new regime, the new government's methods had become increasingly dictatorial; in the face of growing protests and violent terrorist groups, a covert branch of intelligence called the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] (GAG) was created. Tasked with finding and eliminating those who threatened galactic peace and order, the members of the GAG would not only subject a suspect to torture, but also arrest her or his entire family and make them watch. After the defeat of [[Darth Caedus]], the leader of the GAG, who had also elevated himself to the position of president of the Galactic Alliance, the GAG was formally disbanded.<ref name="GOI">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>

During the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|reign]] of [[Darth Krayt]] [[130 ABY|more than a century later]], the agency in charge of torture was [[Sith Intelligence and Assassination]].<ref name="LB" />

Torture varied in both method and purpose between species and cultures. One notable example was the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], who glorified pain not only as a motive for action, but also as a state of living. The Vong [[warrior caste]] derived perverse pleasure from their own pain and from the pain of others.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

Curiously, the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] first name ''Flayss'' meant fate, specifically ''fate of death by slow torture''.<ref name="Galactic Campaign Guide">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Methods==
{{Quote|I didn't think such pain existed. In ''any'' universe.|Princess Leia, after being tortured by Darth Vader on the Death Star|<ref name="CTE" />}}
There was no set standard as to what could or could not be used for torture. Victims were usually held in place with restraints (for example with binders,<ref name="R78">[[Republic 78|''Republic'' 78]]</ref> shackles,<ref name="Crimson" /> ropes,<ref name="Star Wars: Vader's Quest">''[[Star Wars: Vader's Quest]]''</ref> or restraints that were part of the torture mechanism itself<ref name="SWEV" />) or rendered immobile by other means (like the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Containment field/Legends|containment field]]<ref>Name: ''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'', as a tool: [[Jedi: Count Dooku]]</ref>), to lessen any potential opportunity for escape. Sometimes, the person was stripped of most of their clothing; a member of a hairy species might have their fur shaved off,<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> or an avian species their plumage plucked out<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>). The victim might also be imprisoned within a cold, dark cell, adding to their misery.<ref name="Invincible" /> The torturer would often taunt and mentally abuse the victim both during and after the ordeal.<ref name="XWRL">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing: Rogue Leader]]''</ref>

Physical torture methods ranged from a beating with nothing more than fists and boots,<ref name="TZ">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref> to the use of sophisticated custom-designed devices such as the [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O Interrogator]] droid.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Other types of torture could include sensory manipulation,<ref name="TTTB" /> sleep deprivation,<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref> uncomfortable extremes of heat and cold,<ref name="XWKT" /> loud noises,<ref name="SWEV" /> radiation,<ref name="SJDD">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/demagol/index.html?page=1|text="The Secret Journal of Doctor Demagol"|int=The Secret Journal of Doctor Demagol (article)|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref> or any other means that inflicted physical pain.

Psychological torture used non-physical methods to cause extreme mental suffering.<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref> Torture was sometimes combined with a false display of sympathy or affection from the torturer, such as expressed regret for having to put the victim through the procedure, and/or tending to their injuries. A similar way of manipulation was through [[Reproduction/Legends|sexual]] seduction.<ref name="Invincible" />

Some people utilized their torture skills as an occupation,<ref name="SC">{{Tales|7|Single Cell}}</ref> and were paid to glean desired info out of their contracted victims.<ref name="SWEIA">''[[Star Wars: Empire: Idiot's Array]]''</ref> Others, like the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] (of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|New Sith Empire]])<ref name="ORR" /> and [[Darth Maladi]] (of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]])<ref name="L0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref> were experts in the field. Lord Scourge viewed effective interrogation as an art. He knew what questions to ask and in what order, when to ratchet up the intensity and when to pull back, how to use the threat of pain and the reward of mercy to control his victims, how to use multiple sessions over several days when necessary in order to achieve the desired results. In his mind, the ultimate failure was to push his victims too far and accidentally [[Death/Legends|kill]] them; one could get no answers from corpse.<ref name="ORR" />

Some [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], like [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], would gladly torture their bounties if they were paid to or as necessary to extract information.<ref name="MA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>

===Blows===
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was captured by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his brother, [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. The two beat Kenobi viciously, before Maul produced [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]], informing Kenobi that he would make sure he stayed awake long enough to feel every single cut, and that his death would be "beyond excruciating." Fortunately for Obi-Wan, he was able to escape before Maul could finish the job.<ref name="Revenge">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref>

The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Walon Vau]] performed physical torture upon a group of captured terrorists, in the days just after the first anniversary of the start of the Clone Wars. Vau, along with a team of Mandalorians, [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], was assigned to destroy a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and terror network on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They captured group of Separatist terrorists, [[M'truli]], [[Gysk]] and [[Farr Orjul]], and took them to a soundproof apartment. There Walon Vau proceeded to beat information out of them, to the point that the walls were splattered with blood. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arligan Zey]] knew how the prisoners were treated, but chose to turn a blind eye to it, whereas Jedi Knight [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] helped Vau finish his job by torturing Orjul with her own [[The Force/Legends|psychic powers]].<ref name="TZ" />

During the [[Black Fleet Crisis]] more than 35 years later, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was being held captive by [[Nil Spaar]]. To intimidate the [[President/Legends|President]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Han's wife [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], Spaar brutally beat, kicked and hurled about a bound Han for nearly twenty minutes, while Leia was watching via a holotransmission. Han's blood was smeared on the walls and the floor, and even on Spaar's arms.<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>

[[File:Branding.jpg|thumb|right|240px|An Imperial officer branding an [[Unidentified Rebel soldier (Keskin)|unidentified Rebel soldier]]]]

===Bone breaking===
One way to torture the victim was to break one or more of the bones in her or his body. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] used this method to tear information out of people to find the location of her bounty, [[Jax Pavan]].<ref name="SOS" /> When the young [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Deena Shan]] was confronted by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Red Rishyk]], Rishyk decided to toy with her before killing her<ref name="Rebellion 12">[[Rebellion 12|''Rebellion'' 12]]</ref> and got the idea of breaking every single bone in her body. Fortunately for Deena, Rishyk was killed before he could make good on his threats.<ref name="R13">[[Rebellion 13|''Rebellion'' 13]]</ref>

===Branding===
{{Quote|One can do some interesting things with a saber, you know. I'll do my best to show you all of them if you'll cooperate by not passing out.|Darth Vader to Princess Leia, on Mimban|<ref name="SOTME" />}}
Branding involved using red-hot metal to burn the victim's flesh.<ref>''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]'' (meaning of word) and [[Rebellion 1|''Rebellion'' 1]] (used as method of torture)</ref> The same effect could be achieved by [[Laser/Legends|lasers]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] intended to exact revenge on [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] by torturing him with [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]], stating "I will make sure you stay awake long enough to feel every single cut. Your death will be beyond excruciating." However, Obi-Wan managed to escape before Maul had the chance to do what he intended.<ref name="Revenge" />

When [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was forced to fight [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Vader merely toyed with her, repeatedly [[Shiim/Legends|slashing her skin]] with [[Darth Vader's lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]], leaving several black scorch marks on her body.<ref name="SOTME">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>

===The Burning===
[[The Burning/Legends|The Burning]] was a form of torture involving the use of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] set at low power, to scorch the flesh of an individual's body, leaving only blood-smeared bone. Usually, the interrogator would begin with a leg; immobilizing the victim, then continuing the process with other parts of the victim's body, burning off the flesh, inch by inch. Other prisoners were usually made to watch, as part of a psychological torture meant to break their will.<ref name="End">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>

[[Jedi historian]] [[Tionne Solusar]] fell victim to an act of violence very similar to The Burning. During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] was ordered by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] to kill every [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. To draw other Jedi out of hiding, Master Solusar was held fast by Major [[Salle Serpa]], who fired his blaster several times, burning away the lower part of her leg and most of her arm. Tionne fell to the ground writhing in pain, as the helpless Jedi trainees looked on. Then, as a literal "insult to injury," Serpa fired another blaster shot at the stump that was Tionne's brutalized arm, searing off even more flesh and bone.<ref name="I">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>

===Chemical torment===
[[File:Demagol-syringe.jpg|thumb|left|235px|Mandalorian "Doctor" [[Demagol]] prepares to inject the contents of a syringe into a victim.]]
In [[980 BBY]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] was subjected to chemical-induced torture by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Serra]], who believed him to be responsible for the death of her father, [[Caleb]]. Serra kept Bane imprisoned in a closed-down prison and torture facility called the [[Stone Prison]], where she injected various compounds into his [[Blood/Legends|bloodstream]] via the veins in his neck, making his body convulse in seizures.<ref name="DBDE" />

Almost ten years before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], Jedi Master [[Tahl]] was kidnapped by the [[Absolutes|Absolute]] [[Balog (Human)|Balog]], injected with a paralyzing drug that kept her conscious, but immobilized, and put in a sensory deprivation device. She was still alive when her love, [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], arrived to rescue her, but the damage to her inner organs was severe, and he was unable to save her.<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Death of Hope">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Death of Hope]]''</ref>

Imperial torture devices were often equipped with diagnostic scanners that would anticipate a prisoner's loss of consciousness, with chemical injectors keeping her or him awake and conscious during every second of the ordeal.<ref name="ESBJR">[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]]</ref>

The Imperial Moff [[Kentor Sarne]] was fond of using exotic and painful pharmaceuticals to torture his prisoners. The liquid was injected into the victim's body with a hypo syringe, making the prisoner feel like the blood was boiling in their veins.<ref name="DC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref>

[[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] employed many kinds of interrogation drugs, like [[Xebonica]] and [[Mangoriza]], to tear information from the prisoner.<ref>''Chemical Security Protocols'' (appendix to ''[[Desperate Measures]]'') in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 10]]</ref>

Technology could be used for locating pain stimulators and damping the victim's endorphins, making the slightest scratch feel like agony.<ref name="JS" /> A victim could also be injected with pain-enhancing drugs.<ref name="TBH">''[[Tales of the Bounty Hunters]]''</ref> [[Bavo Six]] was a powerful liquid chemical notable for being used in the large syringes of [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O]] [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droids]]. The serum could lower pain thresholds, stimulate cooperation and trigger hallucinations.<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

Torture could be combined with truth drugs<ref>[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']] and ''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> and/or chemicals designed to break the victim's will.<ref name="JS" /> [[OV600]] was a peculiar type of truth serum which caused the victim's flesh to break out in a painful rash if the drug detected the tendencies of lies.<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref> Another powerful truth drug was [[Skirtopanol/Legends|skirtopanol]],<ref name="XWKT" /> whereas [[loquasin]] had the peculiar effects of compelling the victim to ''talk'', but the drug alone could not force the victim to say what the ''interrogators'' wanted&mdash;the victim could just as well talk, or even sing, about something else.<ref name="TTBSB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>

[[Titroxinate]] was a potent neurotoxin which could be used both as a biological weapon,<ref name="MedStar I: Battle Surgeons">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> and as a torture method.<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission">''[[The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission]]''</ref>

After [[Cade Skywalker]] was captured by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], he was taken to [[Darth Maladi's laboratory]], where he was tortured for a whole day, being injected with lethal [[Ixetal cilona/Legends|ixetal cilona]] again and again, to see if he was able to heal himself.<ref name="Legacy 2006 15">[[Legacy (2006) 15|''Legacy'' (2006) 15]]</ref>

===Cutting===
{{Quote|I fell in love with a Mandalorian girl, married into the clans, and a ''hut'uun'' killed her. I know his name. I'll find him. And then I'll show him what it means to make a bad enemy of a Mandalorian with anatomical expertise and a scalpel.|Mandalorian [[Mij Gilamar]]|<ref name="O66:ARCN">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
[[File:AsajjAlpha-knife.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Asajj Ventress torturing Alpha-17 with a knife]]
When the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] sought information on his fellow Sith Lord [[Darth Nyriss]] in [[3954 BBY]], he tortured her adviser [[Sechel]] by cutting off some of Sechel's facial tendrils, and threatened to take one of his eyes as well.<ref name="ORR" />

During the Clone Wars, Obi-Wan Kenobi and [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha]] were presumed dead after an explosion during the [[Battle of Jabiim]].<ref name="Republic 55">[[Republic 55|''Republic'' 55]]</ref> They had actually been captured by the Dark Jedi [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], and transported to her [[Castle Ventress|stronghold]] on [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]]. There she tortured them to obtain information about [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic troop]] movements. One of her methods was cutting Kenobi and Alpha with a knife again and again.<ref name="R60">[[Republic 60|''Republic'' 60]]</ref> When [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] was searching for [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he interrogated a mechanic and threatened to torture him with a [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusioncutter]] if he didn't give him the information he wanted. The terrified mechanic revealed everything.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II comic">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref> [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] associate [[Zekka Thyne]] would sometimes kill those who displeased him, slowly with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]], a weapon which he was a real artist with.<ref name="Side Trip">"[[Side Trip]]"</ref>

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|mysterious epidemic]] broke out on the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']]. In the ensuing chaos, [[Kale Longo|Kale]] and [[Trig Longo]] came across the body of a dead guard who had been tied to the bars by two, now dead from disease, inmates. The two prisoners had somehow managed to lure the guard close enough to the detention cell to bind him, and then tortured him to death by stabbing, slashing and mutilating him with the crude, sharpened instruments still clutched in their dead hands.<ref name="DT">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref>

When [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] was captured by the [[Intendant caste|Intendant]] [[Nom Anor]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], she was hit across the legs again and again with a heavy, sharp object.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Balance Point">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref> During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], [[Imperial Knight]] [[Antares Draco]] was captured by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Havok]]. Deep in the dungeons on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], Draco was subject to the torture inflicted by his former Master, who hoped to extract information from his captive. Havok used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to cut Draco's body with shards of [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] in between healing periods in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]], keeping Draco from dying before he could tell them the secrets Havok was seeking. Draco refused to talk, firm in his conviction that he would rather die.<ref name="Legacy—War 1">[[Legacy — War 1|''Legacy — War'' 1]]</ref>

Another presumably more painful and terrifying variant consisted of cutting out the victim's inner organs one by one, while the victim was conscious.<ref name="Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]''</ref> [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] had seen, and sometimes committed, deeds such as "evisceration of the body."<ref name="Ascension" /> A similar method involved cutting off flesh<ref name="Star Wars: Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand">''[[Star Wars: Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand]]''</ref> or body parts; for example, the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] killed the [[Force healing/Legends|healer]] [[Caleb]] by cutting him to pieces with her lightsaber.<ref name="DBRT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> [[Burra Stone]], who took great pleasure in torturing his victims and was the most feared interrogator in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], once threatened to pull every hair from an Imperial steward's body&mdash;from the inside, and was utterly serious about it.<ref name="Star Wars Missions 14: The Monsters of Dweem">''[[Star Wars Missions 14: The Monsters of Dweem]]''</ref> When the mysterious being [[Abeloth]] visited the Lost Tribe of Sith on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] in [[44 ABY]], she sent out a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] shock wave that destroyed Kesh's city of [[Tahv]] and killed millions of citizens; the ones closest to her imploded, the ones who were farther away were "turned inside out and chunks were ripped from their bones," the rest were killed by a wind filled with glass shards which melted as they pierced flesh, spreading "white-hot, painful death."<ref name="Ascension" />

===Deprivation===
To soften up the victim and break down their resistance before the actual torture session, the victim could be deprived of sleep<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref> (sleep deprivation was considered to be a cardinal factor in a successful interrogation<ref name="The Last Jedi novel">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>) or be kept waiting without food or water for long periods of time.<ref name="TTTB" /> One could also be tortured by being deprived from touching the Force, as was the case with [[Miko Reglia]], who was broken down by a [[Yammosk]].<ref name="VP" />

Torture could also be combined with long periods of solitary confinement, which to some people could be harder to endure than the torture itself, because the mental anguish of loneliness and isolation would eat away at the mind and the spirit.<ref name="ORR" />

After Imperial [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Bertroff Hissa]] was found guilty of [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], [[Supreme Prophet]] [[Rajah Ubooki|Kadann]] sentenced him to a painful and unusual punishment. Hissa would be starved, and then, at the brink of insanity, served a meal of parasite-infested biscuits. The parasites would then slowly eat him from the inside out, until he was dead. However, Hissa ended up being killed before the punishment was carried out.<ref name="PDS">[[Prophets of the Dark Side (novel)|''Prophets of the Dark Side'']]</ref>

===Electric shock===
{{Quote|Simply open this little box of yours so I can get the information from this crystal and your suffering will come to an end.''"<br />"''You will&hellip;never&hellip;get me to&hellip;unlock the&hellip;holocron.''"<br />"''Unfortunately I don't have time to discuss this with you. Hit him again, full power.|Cad Bane and Bolla Ropal|audio=RopalTortured-CoD.flac|<ref name="CD" />}}
[[File:TholmeTorture-SWR43.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Tholme being electrically shocked]]
In [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], while being a prisoner of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Kh'aris Fenn]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] was introduced to Fenn's droid [[AX/RX]], which tortured the Jedi Master through powerful electric jolts. Fenn ordered the droid to keep torturing Tholme until he was oblivious, but Tholme used the Force to drop his vital signs, making the droid believe he was unconscious, before throwing the Jedi in a cell.<ref name="RP">''[[Star Wars: Rite of Passage]]''</ref>

During the Clone Wars, Jedi Knights [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], along with Anakin's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], were captured by the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Overseer/Legends|Overseer]] [[Juhm]] after a failed attempt to free Juhm's [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] from captivity, on [[Gwori]]. As a reminder to the slaves that they were firmly under the overseer's control, the four were placed against [[shocker stick]]s, torture devices which delivered electrical shocks through restraints on the victim's [[Foot/Legends|feet]] and [[Limb/Legends|hands]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom">''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]''</ref>

This wasn't the only time the three Jedi were tortured with electricity. Kenobi and Skywalker suffered torture via electricity when they taken hostage by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] during the war,<ref name="The Gungan General">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref> and Ahsoka Tano was at one point captured by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]. The [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] managed to electrify the young Jedi into unconsciousness, then placed the Jedi in [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun cuffs]]. After confiscating Tano's [[Padawan braid/Legends|Padawan braid]], he then proceeded to shock her repeatedly to increase her master's sense of urgency.<ref name="CD">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref> Ahsoka was also electrically tortured during their [[Mission to Zygerria/Legends|Mission to Zygerria]]. She was shocked several times via a [[Shock collar/Legends|slaving collar]],<ref name="Slaves">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref> a device used by [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] slavers to keep the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] in line.<ref name="Kadavo">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref>

Anakin had previously been forced to watch his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], being tortured by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]]. Amidala and her fellow [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] had been captured while searching for a secret [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] bio-weapons lab on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. When Anakin entered Vindi's lab, he found Vindi torturing his captives with electricity, forcing Anakin and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to surrender. Anakin managed to break free and save the hostages, while Vindi ran off with the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] bomb.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus episode">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref>

[[File:Ropal_tortured.png|thumb|right|320px|Bolla Ropal is tortured by a MagnaGuard.]]
After Ahsoka's encounter with Cad Bane, Bane hunted down [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] in order to unlock the information in the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]] stolen from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Ropal was defeated during the battle and imprisoned in the cell blocks of [[Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Bane's ''Munificent''-class frigate]], where he was placed within a magnetic containment field. Ropal's droid captors attached [[Mind limiter/Legends|mind limiters]] and [[Pain pulser/Legends|pain pulsers]] to his body and injected him with a full dose of the drug [[X-C33/Legends|X-C33]]. Bane demanded that Ropal assist him in opening the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], but Ropal refused, and was electrically shocked several times. After one final refusal from Ropal, Bane ordered the [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuard]] overseeing the torture to electrocute the Jedi at full power. Ropal died, and his limp body was dropped to the floor.<ref name="CD" />

Also during the Clone Wars, the Jedi on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] received a [[Hologram/Legends|holo]]-transmission from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], in which the general showed his victory over the Jedi by having one of his MagnaGuards torture [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]]. After the transmission ended, Koth was put in electric bindings and tortured by [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[TV-94/Legends|TV-94]], who wore a wrist gauntlet that controlled the [[Force field/Legends|energy field]] used to torture the Jedi.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref>

[[General/Legends|General]] [[Kalani/Legends|Kalani]] was a [[Super tactical droid/Legends|super tactical droid]] sent by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to handle the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|local rebellion]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the Clone Wars. After one of the rebels, [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]], was captured, Kalani had Gerrera tortured with a sophisticated electroshock machine in order to interrogate the rebel.<ref name="The Soft War">{{TCW|The Soft War}}</ref>

Shortly after the declaration of the Galactic Empire, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Schurk-Heren]] was shackled to a table and electrically shocked by [[Haka Hai]]'s men, to make him reveal where he hid the contraband he had promised to sell Hai. When Schurk-Heren passed out, they proceeded to treat one of his companions, the [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] [[Bomo Greenbark]], the same way, but Bomo escaped by pretending to also be unconscious, and then using his horns to break the chains holding him.<ref>[[Dark Times 8|''Dark Times'' 8]] and [[Dark Times 9|''Part 4'']]</ref>

One week after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]] was captured by the sadist Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Weir/Legends|Weir]], who tortured the Rebel with electricity from a live wire. Numb soon broke and supplied Weir with all the information he wanted, including sizes and secret locations of military forces.<ref name="XWRL" />

[[File:MirithPain-CE-4.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Mirith Sinn is subject to excruciating torture by an electroprod.]]
[[7 ABY/Legends|Three years later]], [[Talon Karrde]] mentioned a renegade band of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] who used to torture their prisoners by running electricity through a vat of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]. When the victim was at the brink of death, the electricity was turned off, allowing the bacta to heal the prisoner, only to face a new round of the same torture.<ref name="XWBW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>

The [[Force pike/Legends|force pike]], or electro-jabber, was a spear with a vibrating power tip moving at extreme speed. At lowest setting, the spear would deliver excruciating electrical shocks, higher settings could result in paralysis and death, and at maximum setting, it could slice through everything from flesh and bone to thin [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] plating. The weapon could be used for self-defense, but also as a torture device. The [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guards]] used the force pike mainly as a ceremonial weapon, but sometimes for other reasons; torture was one of them.<ref name="NEGWT" />

Similar electric torture devices were shockprods<ref name="TTBSB" /> and high-voltage [[Electroprod/Legends|electroprods]].<ref name="NEGD" />

The [[Neuronic whip/Legends|neuronic whip]] consisted of a thin strand of wire attached to a handle with a switch on it. By activating the switch, electricity would course through the wire. Anything coming into contact with the electric whip would suffer a debilitating neurological overload; repeated lashings could result in permanent brain damage. Since the whip rarely caused ''physical'' harm, it was often used by slavers.<ref name="NEGWT" />

===Flames===
Sometimes, fire was utilized as a form of painful execution. In 22 BBY, an unidentified clone trooper was briefly tortured before being killed when he fell into a molten smelting inside of the cyborg [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous's]] castle on [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Imperial forces tricked a group of resistance leaders fighting the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] (presumably members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]) into entering a building which was then closed from the outside, before the soldiers torched the building.<ref name="SWR">[[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]</ref> [[7 ABY/Legends|7.5]] years later, several members of [[Wraith Squadron]] planned to hit the [[Binring Biomedical Product]] facility on [[Saffalore]], only to discover that the entire facility was a trap. Suddenly, a trap door dropped the Wraiths into an incinerator. They escaped after blasting the wall with explosives, but many of them sustained nasty burns and other serious injuries.<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>

The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] were cunning warriors who didn't think twice about cooking an enemy alive over open flames.<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

===Force-augmented torture===
====Force lightning====
{{Main|Force lightning/Legends}}
{{Quote|Behold the naked energies of the dark side, the lightning of pure willpower. Now, feel its fury!|Darth Sidious to Luke Skywalker, before torturing Luke with Force lightning.|<ref name="RotJrd">[[Return of the Jedi (radio)|''Return of the Jedi'' radio drama]]</ref>}}
[[File:Tortured_Maul.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] sadistically electrifying his beaten [[Darth Maul/Legends|former apprentice]]]]
[[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] was a well known Force ability associated with [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the dark side of the Force. The attack channeled Force energy down the user's limbs, hurling arcing bolts of electricity from the wielder's hands. Force lightning caused unbearable pain, while slowly diminishing the victim's life. It was also nearly impossible to deflect.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force real-life book">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> When the electricity hit the victim, it felt like searing every nerve back into its individual cells, skewering each of them on white-hot needles.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed novelization">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>

In [[3998 BBY]], the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] Jedi [[Arca Jeth]] was captured by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. With the assistance of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Freedon Nadd]]'s spirit, the king attempted to torture Arca to the brink of death with a lightning-based attack, believing that the Jedi Master would be forced to call upon the dark side of the Force to save himself. At that point, Ommin planned to destroy Arca's body and raise the fallen Jedi as a dark side spirit.<ref>''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising]]'' and ''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref>

In [[3956 BBY]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Malak]] captured Jedi [[Bastila Shan]]. In order to force her into accepting the dark side, he relentlessly tortured her for a week through the use of Force lightning. She eventually fell to the dark side and became his apprentice, although she was later eased back to the light side by a redeemed [[Revan/Legends|Revan]].<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

During the [[Battle of Alderaan]] in [[3653 BBY]], a [[Unidentified Zabrak Jedi (Battle of Alderaan)|Zabrak Jedi]] engaged in [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|personal combat]] with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]]. Malgus attacked the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] with Force lightning, burning the Jedi's flesh and blasting dark holes in his body, until the Zabrak dropped to the ground in defeat, screaming. The Sith took a moment to observe the look of failure in the Jedi's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] before [[Shiak|impaling]] him with his lightsaber.<ref name="The Old Republic: The Third Lesson">{{InsiderCite|124|The Old Republic: The Third Lesson}}</ref>

[[File:LukeForcelightning.png|thumb|250px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in excruciating pain while being hit by Sidious' lightning]]
In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Jedi Master [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] embarked on a mission to the Twi'lek planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], in search of his missing apprentice, [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]. When Quinlan confronted Aayla's uncle [[Pol Secura]], who had taken her and was feeding her [[glitteryll]] (a powerful memory-reducing narcotic), he tortured the Twi'lek [[Gender/Legends|man]] with Force lightning. Just as Pol confessed about where the supply of glitteryll was coming from, he was accidentally [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|Force pushed]] from a balcony by Aayla.<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Twilight">''[[Star Wars: Twilight]]''</ref>

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], having been [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|bested]] in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] and telekinetically bashed by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], Darth Maul pleaded mercy from his former [[Sith Master/Legends|mentor]]; he knew how cruel Sidious could be, and he desired a quick, painless death. But Sidious smiled, saying that there ''was'' no mercy, and unleashed a burst of Force lightning on Maul. He paused to prolong Maul's suffering with "assurances" of being spared, for he had "other uses" for the Zabrak. Sidious' chuckling was drowned by continued crackling of lightning and Maul's howls of agony.<ref name="Lawless">{{TCW|The Lawless}}</ref> [[4 ABY/Legends|Decades later]], when the Jedi Knight [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] refused to join Sidious, the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] tormented Skywalker with Force lightning, beginning with an agonizing but non-lethal barrage, working his way gradually upwards in lethality in order to maximize the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] suffering.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

In [[137 ABY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Marasiah Fel]] was taken captive by the Sith and taken to [[XoXaan's Temple]]'s [[Chambers of Persuasion]], where she was tortured and interrogated by [[Darth Havok]]. She resisted Havok's torture, which included Force lightning attacks.<ref name="L49">[[Legacy (2006) 49|''Legacy'' (2006) 49]]</ref>

====Force net====
{{Main|Force net}}
A [[Force net]] was an unusual [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Force power/Legends|technique]] where the user would summon [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] strands of energy that would wrap around the target and ensnare it in an unbreakable mesh. The technique was used by [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] to torture and attempt to kill [[Ben Skywalker]] during the [[Battle in the Fallanassi village]] on [[Pydyr]] in [[44 ABY]]. Taalon was slowly constricting the net, with the intention of slowly, painfully chopping his victim into tiny squares of meat and bone. An unsuspecting Taalon was killed by [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] before the net could do any permanent damage to Ben.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

====Memory Walk====
{{Main|Memory Walk}}
The [[Sorcerers of Tund/Legends|Sorcerer of Tund]] [[Rokur Gepta]] developed a Force ability called [[Memory Walk]], in which the subject was forced to relive all the worst memories and horrors of their life, everything from the merely embarrassing ones to the painful ones, but would not experience anything but the fear. The victim was forced to relive their nightmares over and over again, for days or weeks, until their will and resolve were utterly crushed. A few years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was captured and tortured by Gepta, who subjected Lando to his unique torture method. Fortunately for Lando, he was able to escape.<ref>''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'' - identified as [[Memory Walk]] in ''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>

====Mind Shard====
{{Main|Mind Shard}}
[[Mind Shard]] was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] to mentally splinter an opponent's mind, causing him or her excruciating pain.<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>

====Sith poison====
{{Main|Sith poison}}
{{Quote|Oh, he doesn't have to die, if his Jedi power can neutralize my Sith poison!|[[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]]|audio=SithPoison-DLOTS.flac|<ref name="DLotSad">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
Poisons were a tool, often implemented for a number of reasons during torture sessions. This was the case with [[Sith poison]]; a dark side-infused toxin created through the arts of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]. Once introduced to the bloodstream of a Force-sensitive individual, the poison wears away their resistance to the dark side of the Force. The victim suffers extreme anguish while being consumed by the dark side, over a prolonged period of time.<ref name="DSS">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] was administered a Sith poison by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]], while being tortured by specialized droids, and interrogated about his intentions on [[Empress Teta/Legends|Keto's homeworld]].<ref name="DLS4">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 4]]</ref>

====Sith sorcery====
{{Main|Sith magic}}
{{Quote|I can use my powers to conjure up your worst nightmares and bring them to life before your eyes. I can drive you mad with fear, shred your sanity, and leave you a raving lunatic for the rest of your life|Darth Zannah, describing the effects of her powers to [[Caleb]]|<ref name="DBRT" />}}
[[File:SynBlue-infected.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Deliah Blue]] and [[Jariah Syn]], tormented by a combination of [[Yorik-Kul|Vong spores]] and the dark side]]
Sith sorcery granted its masters an affinity for a power that subjected victims to bouts of utter terror, anguish, and despair. By influencing a person's mind, the sorcerer could make a victim relive their worst fears or nightmares, to such an extreme that the victim would be driven to madness in a desperate attempt to escape the horrors, only to feel them inside their head and mind instead, as the power attacked all aspects of the victim's sensory perceptions.<ref name="DBRT" />

At one point, this [[Summon fear|technique]] was used by the female Sith Lord [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], which left the [[Anti-Republic Liberation Front]] member [[Cyndra]] in a permanent catatonic state.<ref name="DBRT" /> Darth Maul may have applied it to counter the [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] efforts of an [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]], killing him within seconds and leaving him with a terrified, tormented expression on his face.<ref name="DM4">[[Darth Maul (2000) 4|''Darth Maul'' (2000) 4]]</ref> [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]] was another master of this art.<ref name="Legacy 2006 27">[[Legacy (2006) 27|''Legacy'' (2006) 27]]</ref>

====Other Force abilities used for torture====
Even some proponents of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] resorted to torture on occasion. Jedi Knight [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] tortured the terrorist [[Farr Orjul]] mentally by projecting her own fear of being devoid of any direction into his mind by way of denial. Ignoring his gasping, squealing, panting, and sobbing, she tortured him for an hour, before Orjul broke down and revealed everything. Etain justified her actions by claiming that she did it all without anger, which a Jedi wasn't supposed to feel, and that being serene made her actions acceptable.<ref name="TZ" />

Immediately after the capture of [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker learned that a supply [[Starship/Legends|ship]] carrying [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] had been taken over by [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worm]]-infested [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. Skywalker attempted to use a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on the Archduke to make him talk, but Poggle informed him that mind tricks wouldn't work on [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]]. An angry Skywalker told Poggle that he didn't need mind tricks to make him cooperate, and used the Force to choke and levitate Poggle until he finally explained that the brain worms were vulnerable to cold temperatures. Skywalker's fellow Jedi were curious as to how Skywalker had managed to get Poggle to cooperate, but he didn't elaborate.<ref name="Brain Invaders">{{TCW|Brain Invaders}}</ref>

Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Skywalker, who had now become the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Vader, embarked on a mission to [[Vohai]], in search of new [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] technologies. On [[Vohai]], Vader was attacked by the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Sa Cuis]], who was easily overpowered by the Dark Lord. Vader then tortured Cuis via [[Telekinesis/Legends#Choking powers|Force choke]], bringing him to the brink of death again and again, in an attempt to force Cuis to reveal who sent him. He was subsequently killed by Darth Vader when he refused to reveal his employer.<ref name="In His Image">{{StoryCite|story=In His Image|book=Vader: The Ultimate Guide}}</ref>

When Princess Leia was tortured by Vader in order to learn the location of the hidden [[Great Temple/Legends|Rebel base]], she was injected with mind-altering drugs<ref name="SWR" /> that made her very susceptible to suggestion.<ref name="DB-IT-O">{{DB|droid|ito|IT-O}}</ref> Using his own psychic powers,<ref name="The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader">''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]''</ref> Vader made her believe that she was in unbearable pain&mdash;that her skin was on fire and her flesh being torn apart.<ref name="SWR" />

Three years after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Darth Vader again tortured Leia Organa, as well as [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. While the torture was not augmented by the Force, Vader knew that their anguish would reach Luke Skywalker through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and draw him to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] where he could be captured and delivered to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine.<ref name="SWEV note">{{Film|V}}. ''Note that [[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']] and ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' indicate that only Han and Chewbacca were tortured, whereas ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'' and ''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]'' establish that Leia was indeed tortured as well.''</ref> Han was subjected to the [[scan grid]], Chewie to sonic torture and searing lights.<ref name="EVN">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> Leia, like Han, went through an ordeal with a torture machine,<ref name="DTI">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref> though the details are unknown.

After the assassination attempt on [[Allana Djo Solo|his daughter]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] sought out Allana's great-grandmother [[Ta'a Chume]]. Demanding answers, he pressed his thumbs into the base of her skull, shooting charges of Force energy through her brain, while at the same time expanding his own Force presence into her mind, more and more. After getting the information he wanted, he violently poured Force energy into her head and kept pushing hard into her mind with his own presence, until he sent her into a coma.<ref name="Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref>

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Ailyn Vel]] was caught by the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]]. Believing her to be a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] terrorist, Jacen Solo used the Force to repeatedly slam her head into the table where she was sitting while attempting to enter her mind. This was far more than Ailyn could endure, and she died while being questioned.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

===Mental anguish===
One of the many torture methods of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] involved a type of psychological torment where the Vong would feign the prisoner's execution again and again by repeatedly drawing the victim to within centimeters of the Sharp teeth of a [[yammosk]].<ref name="VP" />

===Rack===
A rack was a torture device that stretched or disjointed the victim. The [[Embrace of Pain]] was one such device.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], "Doctor" [[Demagol]] used a rack in his experiments on [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="SJDD" />

===Sensory deprivation===
When Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn was held captive by scientist Jenna Zan Arbor, he was kept floating in a chamber of vapor without sight or sound, while at the same time being slowly drained of blood.<ref name="Experiment">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Evil Experiment]]''</ref>

===Sonic torture===
Sonic torture involved bombarding the victim with a chaotic blare of loud sounds. After [[Whiplash]] leader [[Thi Xon Yimmon]] was captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], his cell was repeatedly barraged with a cacophonous blend of arrhythmic and atonal sounds. In addition, his cell was continuously bathed in a harsh, white light, adding to his misery.<ref name="The Last Jedi novel" /> The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] was subjected to sonic torture and searing lights after being captured by Darth Vader on Bespin in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="EVN" />

===Stoning===
When an elderly Abyssin lost the [[Species/Legends|species]]' ability to heal quickly, they were expected to voluntarily exile themselves to die in the desert. If they refused, they were brutally stoned by their tribe, and were only allowed to rejoin them if they were able to regenerate after the ordeal. Otherwise, they were ritually and regularly stoned until they died or wandered off to die in the desert.<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>

In [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] society, the punishment for vandalism was strict, and the perpetrator could be sentenced to exile, caning or even being stoned to death.<ref name="NEGAS" />

===Suffocation===
In year [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|mysterious epidemic]] broke out on the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']], and [[Imperial Corrections Officer]] [[Vesek]] was one of many who was sent to the infirmary after contracting the virus. [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]] [[Jareth Sartoris]], desperate to escape the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], used the opportunity to attempt to force the access codes to the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] out of the helpless Vesek. When Vesek refused to give him the codes, Sartoris lost patience and pinched Vesek's nose shut until his face went white and he had no [[Heart/Legends|pulse]]. Vesek only survived the torture thanks to the interference of [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Zahara Cody]].<ref name="DT" />

During the [[Rescue Mission to Dibrook]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Kaye Galfridian]] and her troops discovered a group of hostages trapped in a gelatinous gas chamber inside the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Shaper research facility]]. As Kaye and the soldiers watched in horror, [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] gas was pumped into the chamber, slowly choking the life out of the prisoners. The would-be rescuers only managed to get one of the victims out before Kaye's stepmother, [[Nina Galfridian]] (who had noticed that the prisoners had been implanted with [[Yorik-Kul|surge-coral]], just like the attacking [[thrall]]s at the facility), ordered the troops to pull back. Nina, knowing that there was no hope for the prisoners, then used the ''[[Heart of Artorias]]'' to blow up the compound, killing every thrall and Yuuzhan Vong inside.<ref name="Invasion: Rescues 5">[[Invasion: Rescues 5|''Invasion: Rescues'' 5]]</ref>

===Voodoo===
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|Battle of Dathomir]], the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] used a lock of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] to create a magical [[Voodoo/Legends|voodoo]] doll in the Count's likeness. She used it in conjunction with her [[Dathomir Magic|magic]] to torture Dooku to the point of near-death. Dooku only survived thanks to the interference of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="Massacre">{{TCW|Massacre}}</ref>

===Watching===
A prisoner could be made to watch other victims being tortured, particularly their own friends or family.<ref name="TTTB" /> Jedi Knight [[Ben Skywalker]] suffered in this manner, watching his friend [[Lon Shevu]] be tortured to death by [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Tahiri Veila]].<ref name="Invincible" /> During the onset of the [[Swarm War]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] was made to watch what she was led to believe was [[Han Solo/Legends|her husband]] being tortured. Leia watched in horror as Han's torturer, having at his disposal an entire table full of torture devices, cut off Han's [[Ear/Legends|ear]] and scarred his face with a [[laser scalpel]], all because her interrogator did not believe her statements. Eventually she discovered that Han was perfectly safe; the camera she was watching employed trick photography to give the impression of Han's torture. When they met each other shortly after, Han indeed had both ears and no other scars, much to her relief.<ref name="Dark Nest III: The Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Bant'ena Fhernan]] was taken captive by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] and forced to develop a bioweapon for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]]. When she tried to commit suicide rather than do as she wished, Durd beat her nearly unconscious and said that if she tried again, her mother would die in screaming agony, and he would strap Bant'ena to a chair with her eyelids taped open and make her watch a [[Hologram/Legends|holorecording]] of her mother's death a hundred times over. If she tried again and ''succeeded'', her entire family and close friends would ''all'' die in screaming agony.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>

===Whipping===
{{Quote|Do your worst."''<br />''"Oh, we will. Give 'im another lash!|Fish and a member of [[Ken-Kiba]]'s gang|<ref name="DT17">[[Dark Times 17|''Dark Times'' 17]]</ref>}}
[[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] slavers used [[shock whip]]s for interrogations and to keep rebellious [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] in line.<ref name="Slaves" /><ref name="Kadavo" /> When [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was captured during a [[Mission to Zygerria/Legends|Mission to Zygerria]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he was chained to a wall while a sadistic guard whipped his back to make him talk.<ref name="Slaves" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dass Jennir]] was hired by [[Ember Chankeli]] to rid [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]] of [[Ken-Kiba's spice runner gang]], who operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The gang had an ally of Jennir, an elder man named [[Fish (Human)|Fish]], whipped, in order to force him to reveal Jennir's whereabouts. Fortunately for Fish, Jennir was able to rescue him.<ref name="DT17" />

===Worms and insects===
{{Quote|One bit me, then at the smell of blood the others swarmed over me.|Bevel Lemelisk, describing the voracity of piranha beetles|<ref name="Darksaber" />}}
====Artery worms====
[[File:ArteryWorm-1998StarWars24.jpg|thumb|right|225px|A jar of artery worms]]
A torture method favored by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] involved force feeding or injecting the victim with<ref name="IE3">[[Star Wars (1998) 25|''Star Wars'' (1998) 25]]</ref> liquid containing [[artery worm]]s. Burrowing through the victim's veins,<ref name="IE2">[[Star Wars (1998) 24|''Star Wars'' (1998) 24]]</ref> the worms would feed off the arteries. A Nightsister would survive after a day of torment; others would die, unless they were given a potion containing witch blood, which would rid the victim of the worms, provided they hadn't reached their heart.<ref name="IE3" />

====Bloodslugs====
The [[Lyran bloodslug]] was an omnivorous parasite used as a form of torture and punishment by the crime lords of [[Lyran IV]]. This slug could grow from one to six centimeters long. In its dormant state, it could take nourishment by eating wheat and grain, burrowing through piles of grain by exuding a trace amount of a powerful, toxic acid. If they got close enough to a sleeping (or restrained) person, they would use their venom to burrow into the person's body, and start feeding off the victim's viscera, slowly draining the victim of blood over a period of several weeks. The host would slowly go insane from the pain, and eventually die.<ref name="Creature Feature">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20011213c_slug&c=rpg|series=Creature Feature|text=Lyran Bloodslug}}</ref>

====Lava fleas====
In their larval state, [[Lava flea/Legends|Mustafar lava fleas]] were worm-like borers about half a meter in length. The worms fed on the mineral-rich rock dust from the inner caverns of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], using acidic enzymes to break down the rock into needed nutrients. There were disturbing reports of the acid-filled pre-flea worms being used as a ghastly form of torture.<ref name="NEGAS" />

====Muscle maggots====
[[Muscle maggot]]s were burrowing insects that entered their victims through their muscle tissue, causing extreme pain and anguish. The Dark Jedi [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] used these insects on Obi-Wan Kenobi in her [[Castle Ventress|stronghold]] on [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]]. There, Ventress tortured Kenobi in order to obtain information about [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|troop]] movements.<ref name="R60" />

====Piranha beetles====
[[File:Piranhabeetlebetter.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Piranha beetles were favored by Emperor Palpatine for their voracious nature.]]
Emperor Palpatine himself was quite fond of torturing those of his subordinates who had earned his displeasure, such as [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]] engineer [[Bevel Lemelisk]]. The Emperor subjected Lemelisk to numerous tortures, the first of which was having Lemelisk blinded and consumed by [[Piranha beetle/Legends|piranha beetles]], ultimately resulting in Lemelisk's death. However, to capitalize on his suffering, the Emperor would preserve Lemelisk's mind, and after each of his "deaths," would transfer his essence into that of a preexisting [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] body. Lemelisk was forced to endure seven of these grueling punishments in all.<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>

====Other creatures====
[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] used a kind of bloodsucking worm as a form of torture of prisoners in his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]].<ref name="IWSWT">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>

After Imperial [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Bertroff Hissa]] was found guilty of treason against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], [[Supreme Prophet]] [[Rajah Ubooki|Kadann]] sentenced him to a slow and painful death. Hissa would be starved, and then, at the brink of insanity, served a meal of parasite-infested biscuits. The parasites would then slowly eat him from the inside out, until he was dead. Hissa was killed before the sentence was carried out.<ref name="PDS" />

Aleema Keto owned a pet of an unknown species of serpentine constrictor, and used the beast to kill dissenters to the rule of her Krath government. Aleema often used this pet as a torture and execution device. It secreted a yellow mucus from its quills.

==Technology==
{{Quote|Ah, if these devices could only speak, what tales they would tell!|[[Craw|Dictator-Forever Craw]], commenting on his private torture chamber|<ref name="SWD:SoR3" />}}
===Agony Inducer===
[[The Agony Inducer]] was a small, circular device that could be attached to the ear. Small buttons could be pressed to cause the victim pain. A short time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Remel Fud]] and [[Dafi (bounty hunter)|Dafi]] used an agony inducer on the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]] in order to force him to tell them the location of [[Aduba-3/Legends|Aduba-3]].<ref name="Star Wars 1977 16">[[Star Wars (1977) 16|''Star Wars'' (1977) 16]]</ref>

===Analysis grid===
[[File:Dani12.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Dani is subjected to the tortures of the analysis grid.]]
Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] female [[Dani/Legends|Dani]] was captured by the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] agent [[Den Siva]],<ref name="SW97">[[Star Wars (1977) 97|''Star Wars'' (1977) 97]]</ref> who subjected her to weeks of mental torture and clinical study<ref name="Zeltros: Pleasure Planet">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040129zeltros5|series=Zeltros: Pleasure Planet|text=Part 5: The Zeltron Who Cried}}</ref> before she was rescued. Eager to study the make up of her species, Siva subjected Dani to the [[analysis grid]], a device designed to detect the physiology of a species, by firing coherent beams of energy through a specimen.<ref name="SW97" />

===Carbon freeze===
{{Quote|Well, Calrissian? Did he survive?"<br />"Yes, he's alive...and in perfect hibernation.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], after [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] is frozen in carbonite|<ref name="SWEV" />}}
[[Carbonite/Legends|Carbonite]] was a metal alloy that was mixed with [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna gas]], compressed, and [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|flash-frozen]], encasing materials for transport in an incredibly strong metal alloy. The freezing of living subjects in carbonite was used as a form of torture; the process was excruciating, and the victim was placed in a form of stasis hibernation, while still experiencing a form of consciousness.<ref name="DB-carbon-freezing chamber">{{DB|technology|carbonfreezingchamber|carbon-freezing chamber}}</ref>

===Dreypa's Oubliette===
In the days of the old Sith Empire, torture was known to be a common practice, so much so that ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords of the Sith]] constructed terrible devices and chambers for which their torturous methods could be carried out. One such [[Sith artifact/Legends|prison]] was [[Dreypa's Oubliette]], crafted by a Sith Lord of [[Remulus Dreypa|the same name]]. When a victim of Dreypa's was placed inside the oubliette, they would endure what was described as a living death, being subjected to such torment for as long as they were held captive. Lord Dreypa intended this prison to contain a rival Sith named [[Karness Muur]], and the powerful [[Muur Talisman|talisman]] within his possession, but Dreypa's plan never came to fruition.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 27">[[Knights of the Old Republic 27|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 27]]</ref>

===The Embrace of Pain===
[[File:Embrace_L18.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Cade Skywalker being tortured by Darth Krayt in the Embrace of Pain.]]
{{Quote|The Vong call it the Embrace of Pain. The more you struggle to escape, the more pain it inflicts.|Darth Krayt to Cade Skywalker|<ref name="Legacy18" />}}
The [[Embrace of Pain]] was an organic, rack-like restraint used to torture prisoners. A victim was kept face down in restraint bands, and tortured while the creature would read the electrochemical outputs of the victims nerve impulses and evaluate her or his brain chemistry. The resultant data was used to keep the pain at constant and optimum levels.<ref name="NEGWT" /> The device had a number of different methods for inducing pain, including stretching of ligaments and joints, acid, electric shocks, sharp devices, needles,<ref name="T">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref> thorns, and injected biotoxins.<ref name="I" /> In at least one case, the victim was stripped naked, and all of his hairs pulled out. When the victim was at the brink of dying, the Embrace would tend to the prisoner's body by lowering them to the floor and letting them sleep for a time, while tending wounds and injecting the prisoner with enough water and nutrients to keep them alive.<ref name="T" />

===Nerve disruptor===
The [[Agonizer-6 nerve disruptor]] was an Imperial torture and interrogation device resembling a small, three-legged droid. A built-in droid brain<ref name="NEGWT" /> would closely monitor life indicators like heartbeat, nerve functions and respiration<ref name="EGWT" /> to keep the her or him alive until interrogation was complete.<ref name="NEGWT" /> The disruptor pushed the victim into her or his limits, physical as well as mental. Microfilament injectors caused pain and dispensed truth drugs, while stimulators worked on sensitive nerve clusters, causing aches, tingling, pain or uncontrollable spasms. Nerve stimulation was also used to induce altered states of mind, ranging from euphoria, relaxation, and bliss, to fear, panic, and uncontrollable terror. Emotional states could be artificially enhanced, eventually destroying the victim's mental defenses and break their will.<ref name="EGWT" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] member [[Barid Mesoriaam]] was captured by the gangster [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], and tortured for days for information on the alliance.<ref>''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]'': {{StoryCite|story=Play It Again, Figrin D'an: The Tale of Muftak and Kabe|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>

===Scan grid===
The [[scan grid]] was a rack-like device originally designed to analyze metals, gathering data by emitting electrical charges. When Han Solo was tortured by Darth Vader at Bespin, Vader utilized Cloud City scan grid<ref name="NEGWT" /> which had been heavily modified with additional tools designed for torture, including microsurgical [[vibroscalpel]]s, an electroshock assembly, diagnostic scanners and chemical injectors. The scanners would anticipate loss of consciousness while the chemical injectors kept the victim awake, forcing Han to endure every measure of pain without passing out.<ref name="ESBJR" />

According to [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]], Vader created the design himself.<ref name="XWKT" /> Earlier during the war, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Zuud]] of Imperial Intelligence used the same, or a similar, device to torture the rebel agent [[Jorin Sol]],<ref name="WSW">''[[Star Wars: Empire: The Wrong Side of the War]]''</ref> and Isard herself would use yet another version called the [[Inducer]] to torment [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] several years later. Whereas the original only worked on the pain receptors, the Inducer stimulated the receptors for heat and cold as well, making it feel like one's flesh was burning and the bones were chilled to absolute zero.<ref name="XWKT" />

===Slaving collar===
The [[Shock collar/Legends|slaving collar]] was a neck brace used to control [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and other prisoners. It could be equipped with shock panels that delivered electrical charges at the slavemaster's command.<ref name="NEGWT" />

===Spineray===
[[Spineray]]s were biologically engineered Yuuzhan Vong creatures used for stimulating the nervous system, both for medical purposes and as a means of torture. The ''tracer'' spineray was mainly used to evaluate the condition of organic tissue and for determining an organism's physiological balance, but also served a purpose as a tool for inflicting pain<ref name="NEGWT" /> to selective nerve arrays.<ref name="EVI">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref> Inflicting pain was more often the domain of the ''provoker'' spineray, which would target and incite individual nerve endings,<ref name="NEGWT" /> issuing pain to certain receptors with micromillimeter precision.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref>

The spineray would attach itself to the victim's neural pathways and trigger the body's pain receptors. It could also feel when the person tried to lie or resist, increasing the pain and making it feel like every nerve ending and organ were on fire.<ref name="RESCUES3">[[Invasion: Rescues 3|''Invasion: Rescues'' 3]]</ref>

===Torture chair===
This interrogation and torture device made a victim's muscles jitter and spasm. The seizures were not painful so much as they were maddening. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] used such a chair. A most effective interrogation and torture technique was to have this machine create an unrelenting facial tick that would cause the victim to blink over and over for hours on end.

===Torture droids===
{{Quote|Ulic Qel-Droma: I am only a humble torture droid, while you are a great Jedi Knight.
