My masters are pleased that you have chosen to join the noble Sith, but claims of loyalty must be tested&mdash;and verified.|Ulic, being tortured by a Krath torture droid|audio=UlicQDKrathConflict-DLOTS.flac|<ref name="DLotSad" />}}
====AX/RX====
[[Kh'aris Fenn]] owned a torture droid with the designation [[AX/RX]], capable of inflicting pain through powerful electric shocks. The droid was tasked with torturing Tholme after the Jedi Master was taken captive by Fenn.<ref name="RP" />

====BL-39 interrogator droid====
[[File:BL39InterrogatorDroidVsCodruJiJedi-LECG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A BL-39 interrogator droid corners a [[Codru-Ji]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].]]
The [[BL-39 interrogator droid]] was a direct successor to the Imperial torture droid [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O]]. Following the decline of the Galactic Empire after the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a private company, [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech]], purchased the schematics for the IT-O. High demand from law enforcement agencies and local governments, resulted in the design being adapted to a civilian model.

The droid used many components from modern medical droids, and was capable of extracting information from the reluctant with minimal pain or physical injury. During the reign of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]] made use of these droids in her duties as the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]].<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

====EV supervisor droid====
The [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV supervisor droid]] was manufactured by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]], and planned as a manager droid that could oversee and increase the efficiency of droid labor. During production, the EV motivators for the supervisor droids were mistakenly swapped for [[MDF motivator]]s, contraband hardware designed for torture droids.<ref name="NEGD" /> MerenData didn't notice the error until after<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> hundreds of faulty droids had gone out. The manufacturer blamed it on industrial sabotage, but others attributed it to a fatal combination of malicious intent and stupidity. The mix-up also exposed that MerenData were building illegal droids for the [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]].<ref name="NEGD" /> According to several industry surveys, production lines where the droids were employed boasted a high efficiency rating,<ref name="AIR" /> and the faulty models were outperforming the standard EV units at droid worker motivation.<ref name="NEGD" />

But then the stories trickled in.<ref name="NEGD" /> The MDF Motivator had given the corrupted droids a rather malicious personality, along with a tendency to utilize painful forms of discipline.<ref name="AIR" /> The combination of the MDF motivator's sadism and the EV's power of positive management lead to catastrophe. In a hotel on [[Indu San/Legends|Indu San]], the slowest droids were given oil baths set on fire. Worker droids on Eriadu were having their feet melted to the floor to prevent them from leaving their stations.<ref name="NEGD" /> A report in [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]] described how an EV-droid supervisor working in an automated [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] mistreated the droid crew so badly that an angry [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] blew it out the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]].<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> The droids' brutality extended to the rare cases where they were tasked to supervise organics; on [[Kadril]], employees were prodded with high-voltage [[Electroprod/Legends|electroprods]].<ref name="NEGD" />

MerenData panicked, and made every effort to recall the corrupted droids, but some of them found homes with owners unfazed by their sadistic personalities.<ref name="NEGD" /> One example was certain [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] groups in the Outer Rim who modified their EV droids to serve as torture droids and [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] pen supervisors.<ref name="CFTD" />

'''EV-4D9'''

One example was [[EV-4D9]], employed by the crime boss [[Ploovo Two-For-One/Legends|Ploovo Two-For-One]].<ref name="NEGD" /> One of its previous owners had noticed the droids habits, and enhanced its brutality even more by a little bit of programming, processors from an older torture droid and adding a few pain tools, including a thermal drill, an arc welder, a plasteel cutter and three solution injectors that could by loaded with a variety of pain- and truth-serums. The droid eventually came into the ownership of [[Lotas]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] employed by the crime boss.<ref name="AIR" />

'''EV-9D9.2'''

Yet another unit was [[EV-9D9.2]], which took over as chief of interrogation on the assembly moon of [[Telti/Legends|Telti]].<ref name="NEGD" /> This droid was a second generation administrative droid descended from the prototype [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]]. When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] mechanic [[Cole Fardreamer]], who was turned over to EV-9D9.2 after a run-in with [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Brakiss]] in the latter's droid factory, experienced first-hand why the droid was said to be twice as ruthless as its predecessor. Cole managed to escape with the help of [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], who rallied the other droids against EV-9D9.2.<ref name="The New Rebellion">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>

'''EV-9D9 (Eve-Ninedeenine)'''

The most notorious EV droid was [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]],<ref name="NEGD" /> former head of automated security on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], and supervisor of the droid pool at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's palace]]. Even though she left a series of broken droids in her wake, victims of her sadistic streak,<ref name="TJP">''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]''</ref> it is unknown whether she ever harmed any organic beings.

====IT-O====
{{Quote|I've heard whispers about these droids &mdash; torture devices invented by twisted Imperial minds. It is said that they can deliver unimaginable pain. Pain so intense that it has never been experienced before &mdash; worse than pain from any disease or wound known in the universe.|Princess Leia Organa, prior to her first encounter with an IT-O Interrogator|<ref name="CTE" />}}
[[File:LeiaOrganaTorture-JvS.jpg|thumb|right|220px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] torturing [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] with an IT-O]]
Interrogation droids were used almost exclusively by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and other tyrannical governments. After the Empire rose to power, most droids programmed to cause harm to organic creatures were outlawed, but interrogation droids remained legal, and their existence was not a well-kept secret; rumors of their horrifying techniques and cruelty spread throughout the Empire.<ref name="TotG">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref> Many of the sadistic tendencies shared by [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Imperial Inquisitors]] and [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] agents were programmed into the droids,<ref name="AIR" /> and as a result, Imperial torture droids tended to have decidedly sadistic temperaments.<ref name="EGWT" />

The [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O]] (Eyetee-Oh<ref name="MTS">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>) was a series of Imperial torture droids developed by the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Department of Military Research]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="NEGD" /> A product of military research and the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]], it was manufactured solely by Imperial factories,<ref name="UnCam">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> though the droid was originally devised by the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] as an instrument to torture their prisoners (and not necessarily for information).<ref name="DSS" /> Its reputation was spread far enough that many prisoners confessed as soon as one floated into their cell.<ref name="UnCam" /> [[High Inquisitor]] [[Mox Slosin]], one of the Empire's most efficient interrogators, provided keen insight during the development of the droid.<ref name="AIR" /> The look of the droid was designed to give it an aura of menace.<ref name="UnCam" /> The glossy black globe moved about on small repulsorlifts,<ref name="NEGD" /> dotted with pain-producing equipment, all linked to each other and adapted from top-of-the-line [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] and [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]].<ref name="MTS" /> It also contained an audio and videorecording unit.<ref name="UnCam" /> Combining sophisticated medical science and psychiatric modules with interrogation and torture programs,<ref name="DFRS">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref> the droid would monitor all body functions searching for weaknesses to exploit, chemical as well as physical,<ref name="MTS" /> in order to apply maximum pain with minimal damage.<ref name="DFRS" /> Precise stimulation of nerves assured that the victim was feeling excruciating pain while being kept conscious.<ref name="MTS" /> Some of the equipment and program modules were modified assassin droid parts, linked to medical droid diagnostic and operating modules.<ref name="DFRS" />

Use of the droid was carefully controlled by ISB, though IT-O models did also get into the hands of senior [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], military intelligence and [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]], the near-fanatical military arm of [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]].<ref name="UnCam" /> The droid was especially popular among the Imperial Inquisitors,<ref name="DSS" /> and the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] was secretly manufacturing the model on its own. [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] garrison commanders were also known to make use of them, though generally only under the guidance of a senior officer.<ref name="UnCam" /> The [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] was stocked with IT-Os, exclusively to the domain of detention personnel and security. Few others could bear to watch them in action.<ref name="MTS" />

The IT-Os had much of the same programming and equipment as a medical droid,<ref name="UnCam" /> and were programmed with expertise in psychology, medicine, surgery and human biology.<ref name="NEGD" /> They were capable of monitoring vital signs to prevent the onset of unconsciousness or catalepsy,<ref name="EGD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> even bringing the victim back from the brink of death, only to endure further torture.<ref name="NEGD" /> Its medical equipment and programming could be used if the session went too far before any valuable information could be squeezed out of the victim. The droid was also equipped to bring a victim only to the brink of physical damage.<ref name="UnCam" /> After the victim submitted to the ordeal, the IT-O would evaluate her or his truthfulness, based on heart rate, muscle tension and voice patterns.<ref name="NEGD" />
The torture droid's painful equipment included:
*An oversized hypodermic injector syringe to inject liquid chemicals, including [[Bavo Six]]<ref name="NEGD" />
*An internal reservoir of drugs, ranging from mind altering to lethal<ref name="MTS" />
*Acid jet<ref name="NEGD" />
*Searing flesh pincer<ref name="NEGD" />
*Laser scalpel<ref name="NEGD" />
*Power shear<ref name="NEGD" />
*Grasping claw<ref name="NEGD" />
*Sonic torture device<ref name="NEGD" />
*Flesh peelers<ref name="SWCE" />
*Joint cripplers<ref name="SWCE" />
*Bone fragmenters<ref name="SWCE" />
*Electroshock nerve probes<ref name="SWCE" />
*[[Blaster/Legends|Blaster]]<ref name="UnCam" />
*Needles<ref name="AFA">''[[A Forest Apart]]''</ref>
*Torches<ref name="AFA" />

[[File:Rebeltorture.jpg|thumb|left|190px|The work of a torture droid, seen up close: [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] tortures [[Thurlow Harris]] to extract the name of the pilot who destroyed the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].]]
The droid was also equipped with a vocabulator producing speech; this had seldom been required, as the devices dotting the black sphere spoke for themselves.<ref name="NEGD" /> The droid was still perfectly capable of interrogating a prisoner on its own, speaking in a flat, emotionless monotone. When working with a living, organic assistant, the droid would often keep quiet, allowing the victim to hate and fear the droid, while seeing its living companion as a source of potential mercy.<ref name="UnCam" />

The use of torture droids was ostensibly forbidden in the modern [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="NEGD" /> Even so, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]], who served on the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]] of the Imperial Remnant, kept an IT-O as part of his collection of antiques, and few knew that it was still functional and had been used by the Moff more than once. One such incident occurred when Lecersen was visited by the [[Minyavish]] [[Tiyuu'cha Mahlor]], whose [[Species/Legends|species]] had been exiled from their homeworld, [[Qaras]], by the rebelling [[Jessar]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] population. Mahlor had uncovered evidence of Lecersen's involvement in the [[Freedom Flight]] movement and attempted to blackmail the Moff. Realizing that Mahlor might be in possession of sensitive information, the Moff had him tortured by the IT-O interrogator for hours, until Mahlor revealed everything he knew, at which point Lecersen had the Minyavish painlessly killed.<ref name="Ascension" />

====IT-904====
[[IT-904]] was once an Imperial interrogation droid that was purchased at an auction by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dej Vennor]]. Vennor had the droid extensively modified, augmenting it with additional armaments and upgrading its memory and processing capability. Unlike most other IT-droids, the IT-904 was fiercely independent and was highly sarcastic when dealing with organic lifeforms of all kinds.<ref name="The Far Orbit Project">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref>

====IT-1====
The IT-O was inevitably succeeded with new models with more refined torture equipment,<ref name="NEGD" /> like the [[IT-1]], which was one of the available tools used for interrogation in the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], along with IT-O.<ref name="DSTC">''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''</ref>

====IT-3====
Yet another IT model was the [[IT-3 Interrogator|IT-3]], which was especially popular with [[Ysanne Isard]], Director of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. The IT-3 incorporated even more manipulators and injectors than its predecessor, and had a glossier shine, presumably so that victims could see in their reflection exactly what was done to them during interrogation. In addition to the tools of its predecessor, the droid had three power shears and a trio of syringes. An additional syringe contained [[Sith poison]]. Unlike its prototype, the droid could and would speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] while performing its grisly work, in a motherly, soothing voice, intended to be far more unnerving than a torture droid that remained silent. Most IT-3s were dismantled after [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was liberated from the Empire after the New Republic came to power.<ref name="DSS" />

====IT-O 26====
The [[IT-O 26 Interrogation Droid|IT-O 26]] served the Empire on board the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Desolator (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Desolator'']]. The tools at the droid's disposal included knives, twin hypodermic needles, and a grasping claw delivering electric shocks. The droid's shiny surface allowed the victim to see their own reflection during the torture.<ref name="The Isis Coordinates">''[[The Isis Coordinates]]'', including cover</ref>

====IT-O9====
[[File:TorturedUlic.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], suffering heavily under [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto's]] torture droids]]
Many decades before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[IT-O9]] served the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Riboga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], hovering near his throne whenever he was entertaining his unsavory guests. After the end of his regime of crime in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], it was employed by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]], which had no official need of interrogator droids, and had the droid reprogrammed as a quality control agent.<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

====Krath torture droids====
In [[3996 BBY]], while reigning as Emperor over the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Keto]], kept dissidents in line with the regular use of torture droids. Although their technology was seemingly antiquated, Keto's son Satal found them nonetheless effective when he became co-ruler of Empress Teta.<ref name="DLS1">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 1]]</ref> Some droids could be modified from their primary functions to serve as torture droids. [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]], co-leader of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-inspired [[Krath/Legends|Krath]], used ordinary [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] and modified them to perform surgical tortures on individuals. [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] was a victim of Keto's torturous ways. When Ulic attempted to infiltrate the Krath, Lord Keto had the Jedi restrained in the dungeons of the Krath's [[Iron Citadel/Legends|Iron Citadel]], where Krath torture droids administered excruciating punishments to him.<ref name="DLS4" />

====SD-XX====
Dubbed "Double-X," [[SD-XX]], was Darth Caedus's personal security droid during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. At the end of the war, the droid had been given new assignments as a torture droid. Equipped with a wide array of needles, probes and electrodes hidden inside its fingers, "Double-X" was tasked with torturing Ben Skywalker to find the Jedi's hidden base. After the droid failed to get any information out of Ben, SD-XX was sent to hunt him down after Ben escaped.<ref name="Invincible" />

====Sith torture droid====
During the reign of Darth Krayt, Darth Maladi, head of [[Sith Intelligence and Assassination]], often used [[PI-series medical assistant droid|torture droids]] which appeared as mechanical [[Jellyfish/Legends|jellyfish]] with tentacles consisting of knives, probes, and other devices.<ref>[[Legacy (2006) 9|''Legacy'' (2006) 9]] and [[Legacy (2006) 15|''Legacy'' (2006) 15]]</ref>

====T0-D Interrogation droid====
Yet another torture droid employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was the wheeled [[T0-D interrogation droid|T0-D Interrogation droid]]. It was equipped with two claws and tool mounts, as well as a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]] and a [[Sonic stunner/Legends|sonic stunner]]. The latter creates waves of sonic energy that assaults the victim's aural receptors, creating high-frequency vibration that penetrates the [[Brain/Legends|brain]], causing the victim great pain. Not even deaf people were immune to it.<ref name="TG" />

==Resistance==
{{Quote|Listen, you can go back home and tell everyone you didn't crack, and they'll give you a medal or something.|Dirk Harkness to Jai Raventhorn, after having both endured [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] torture without breaking.|<ref name="GS">{{StoryCite|story=Gathering Shadows|book=Tales from the New Republic}}</ref>}}
Resistance to torture was often associated with interrogation, although the term also applied to brainwashing, endurance and coercing. Technically, ''interrogation'' was asking questions.<ref name="RERSFH">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref> Interrogation usually accompanied torture, with torture itself being the result of the individual's reluctance or outright refusal to cooperate. To make it even harder to resist, the victim's head could be fitted with a scrambler to reduce their resistance to questions.<ref name="TBH" />

Tolerance for pain would help, but according to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]], this was useful only against "the simplest and least effective interrogation method." (Scourge did not elaborate on the details of the more effective methods, but loosely described them as knowing how to counter techniques for interrogation resistance, or learning their tricks by understanding how their mind worked.)<ref name="ORR" />

Many people would resort to desperately babbled lies, evasions and half-truths in a desperate attempt to escape the pain, and therefore, information gathered through torture was often unreliable or even worthless.<ref name="ORR" /> Even so, interrogation through torture was viewed as an effective means of gleaning information from the reluctant, but there were still those who were incapable of breaking, in spite of the extreme anguish.

====Strength of will====
{{Quote|Darn you, Choba, what am I ''paying'' you for?|Jib Kopatha to Choba, while Choba attempts in vain to break Han Solo.|<ref name="SWEIA" />}}
[[File:YaddleTortured.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Even as a Padawan, [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]] was able to resist the totures inflicted by [[Tulak]]]]
Shortly after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Schurk-Heren]] was imprisoned and electrically shocked by [[Haka Hai]], who was hoping to pry the location of some [[Dreypa's Oubliette|mysterious contraband]] out of Schurk-Heren. Hai admitted that he didn't expect him to break, and the smuggler lived up to his expectations.<ref name="DT8">[[Dark Times 8|''Dark Times'' 8]]</ref>

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], while a captive aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] was tortured by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in order to learn the location of the hidden [[Great Temple/Legends|Rebel base]]. Leia was introduced to an [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O torture droid]],<ref name="IT-O NEGD">[[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O Interrogator]] entry in ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> and pain was inflicted through needles,<ref>''[[Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil]]'' and [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref> pressure points, fire-knives<ref name="ROTJN">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref> and electro-shocks.<ref name="Death Star novel">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> Vader also employed mind-altering drugs and subliminal suggestion in his sessions with the Princess, which made Leia believe that her skin was on fire and her flesh being torn apart, causing the same reaction the real thing would.<ref name="SWR" /> Leia maintained her resistance, even when she was near [[Death/Legends|dying]] from the pain.<ref name="SWCE" /> It was only under threat of destroying Leia's homeworld of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] did Leia relent, and expose the location of the decoy rebel base on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Tarkin then obliterated Alderaan anyway, saying that Dantooine was far too remote for an effective demonstration of the Death Star's power.<ref name="ReferenceA">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Shortly after the battle of Yavin, when Leia was once again taken captive by the Empire, the [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] interrogating her didn't even bother inflicting pain, as he had read her file, and knew she'd rather die before she talked.<ref name="Rebel Force: Hostage">''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]''</ref>

While on a mission for the Rebel Alliance, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was captured by the [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Jib Kopatha]]. Desperate to know the location of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel fleet]] to escape Darth Vader's wrath, Kopatha left Han to his own personal torturer, [[Choba]]. Choba was surprised when Han proved to be stronger than the other victims he'd had on his table, and never got the chance to finish the job, as Han was rescued by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and the smuggler [[Sheel Odala]].<ref name="SWEIA" />

Another example was Han and Leia's fellow Rebel [[Mirith Sinn]], who refused to reveal anything while being tormented by [[Carnor Jax]]'s men in order to make her disclose the location of the former [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]] [[Kir Kanos]].<ref name="Crimson" /> Other Rebels who managed to pass the ordeal were [[Dirk Harkness]] and [[Jai Raventhorn]].<ref name="GS" />

In [[137 ABY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Marasiah Fel]] was tortured and interrogated by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Havok]]. She resisted Havok's torture, which included Force lightning attacks.<ref name="L49" />

Many soldiers were trained in interrogation resistance, but if the interrogator also knew the techniques, the interrogator might know how to counter them, making it harder not to break.<ref name="ORR" />

One technique to help a person withstand torture was called "drawing inward";<ref name="RESCUES3" /> this involved breathing techniques, and the visualization of mental images. This drawing inward also separated mind from body, and helped the individual either remain oblivious to the pain to come, or relive the pain from previous moments, thereby ignoring the present torment.<ref name="CTE">''[[Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil]]''</ref> Other ways involved putting one's focus elsewhere,<ref name="GS" /> which could be everything from strong feelings like hatred,<ref name="SC" /> dedication to one's cause,<ref name="TG" /> or pleasant things like the warmth of the [[Star/Legends|sun]].<ref name="CRFG" /> The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Kal Skirata]] taught his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] a technique of resisting interrogation by shutting out reality to become someone else who wasn't in your terrible situation. One way to achieve this was to visualize putting the pain and fear in a box, or concentrating on its physical reality so minutely it fragmented and ceased to register; another method was to imagine you were somewhere else. One could also focus on the next moment one could bear to think about, like the next meal, second, or step, time after time until the ordeal was over.<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

The Jedi of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] were taught to absent the mind from the body when exposed to extreme stimuli. The [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Whiplash]] leader [[Thi Xon Yimmon]], had been tortured once during his youth, and used this technique to deal with it, although he was not a Jedi.<ref name="The Last Jedi novel" />

Mandalorians were trained to endure torture,<ref name="OS2">[[Jango Fett: Open Seasons 2|''Jango Fett: Open Seasons'' 2]]</ref> as were Imperial agents,<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Masquerade">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Masquerade]]''</ref> whereas the Zabraks were known for their incredible willpower, being able to endure intense physical pain and torture without breaking their resolve.<ref name="NEGAS" /> The [[Chalactan Adepts/Legends|Chalactan Adepts]], a philosophical-mystic order of [[Chalactan/Legends|Chalactans]], went through training which made them resistant to all forms of mental manipulation and brainwashing, including by torture.<ref name="Shatterpoint novel">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>

====Force resistance====
{{Quote|You are strong, child&mdash;but I will break you!|Darth Malak, torturing Bastila Shan into accepting the dark side of the Force|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
[[File:Eeth_Koth_SWK_magazine.jpg|thumb|right|170px|The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] had an unusual talent for Crucitorn.]]
Many [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] were able to endure pain through mental focusing techniques, which made them appear somewhat stronger than others in terms of handling pain. One of the methods was a kind of [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]],<ref name="JCD">''[[Jedi: Count Dooku]]''</ref> another way was setting up a Force block in one's mind.<ref name="Invincible" /> Both the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Matukai/Legends|Matukai]] were capable of withstanding enormous amounts of pain.<ref name="Hero's Guide">''[[Hero's Guide]]''</ref> The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] was tortured by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] for months, but never revealed any useful information. Scourge was eventually convinced that torturing Revan was an unproductive waste of time and resources.<ref name="ORR" /> The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]] went through a torture session with the warlord [[Tulak]] without even screaming once.<ref name="Yaddle's Tale: The One Below">{{Tales|5|Yaddle's Tale: The One Below}}</ref> [[Darth Malak|Alek Squinquargesimus]] was skilled at using his Jedi powers to block out pain, which impressed "Doctor" [[Demagol]] greatly while experimenting on [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="SJDD" />

The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] had an outstanding talent for [[Crucitorn (technique)|Crucitorn]], a Jedi technique for transcending physical pain that went far beyond the Zabrak ability to withstand torture.<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> The technique made the user capable of ignoring the debilitating effects of the pain and focus despite great physical trauma.<ref name="JATM" />

When the Jedi [[Yuledan]] was tortured by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], he used the Force and his own strength of will to prevent himself from revealing information to the Vong.<ref name="RESCUES3" /> Initially, he was successful, but eventually, the agony inflicted upon him by a [[spineray]] became too much to bear, and he gave the Vong the information that they sought.<ref name="Invasion: Rescues 4">[[Invasion: Rescues 4|''Invasion: Rescues'' 4]]</ref>

In rare instances, a Force-user's pain control could be circumvented by another Force-user. This was the case of Jedi Master [[Shylar]], who was tortured to death by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and former Jedi, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="JCD" />

==Droids as victims of torture==
{{Quote|Droids don't get hurt, little one. Only damaged.''"<br />"''And sometimes kidnapped and tortured and taken apart. That's not hurt?''"<br />"''Well&hellip; not technically.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]], the latter worried about [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].|<ref name="Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>}}
[[File:ThreepioTortured-EP.png|thumb|left|250px|[[J0-N0/Legends|J0-N0]] torturing [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]]]
[[Droid/Legends|Droids]] could feel pain in their own way if a pain-stimulator button, a tiny device connected by a single wire, was added to their central circuits. This technology was supposedly restricted, and typically installed in droids meant to interact with organics at the most personal level. This was supposed to give them a deeper understanding of organics. Droids equipped with the pain-stimulator would react to pain through pain transmissions and sine waves of pain and despair. They could even be tortured to the point where they stopped functioning.<ref name="TJP" />

Droids were also capable of taking pleasure from the pain of other droids. One notable example was [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]], who existed for bad feelings and enjoyed experimenting with her fellow droids. She took great pleasure from their suffering and despair, and each squeal of despair from her victims was like a surge of fresh current through her circuits. She would record the sensations, playing them back over and over, calling up associative memory files of flavor, texture and shifting densities of sensory input.<ref name="TJP" />

An [[8D8/Legends|8D8]] smelting operator droid worked as a droid torturer in Jabba the Hutt's palace, where his job was to make sure that every droid and [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] knew their place. 8D8 would use red-hot brands to melt the casings of lazy or obstructive droids, or sometimes just for fun, like with the [[Power droid/Legends|power droid]] that [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] saw when they ended up inside 8D8's torture lair after being acquired by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]].<ref name="SWCE" /> During EV-9D9's career at Jabba's palace, 8D8 assisted her in the torture and dismantling of the other droids in Jabba's labor pool. The 8D8s were one of the most mean-spirited droids in service in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="NEGD" />

==Cultural significance==
{{Quote|You expect to be tortured?"''<br />''"Some cultures would not hesitate to use torture.|[[Freedom Flight]] member [[Blink]], and [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Madhi Vaandt]]|<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>}}
===Abyssin===
Abyssin could heal quickly and regenerate any body part, but when an elderly Abyssin lost these regenerative abilities, they were expected to voluntarily exile themselves to [[Death/Legends|die]] in the desert. If they refused, they were brutally stoned by their tribe. If the elder was able to regenerate after the ordeal, they were allowed to rejoin the tribe; otherwise, they were ritually and regularly stoned until they died or gave in to tradition and wandered off to die in the desert.<ref name="GG4" />

===Colicoids===
[[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] were cannibalistic, emotionless and vicious beings.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> Those unfortunate enough to be caught in the middle of their feeding frenzy, risked being eaten alive; if given the chance, the Colicoids would pounce on the victim, quickly stripping bones of meat and flesh, slicing and dicing her or him like filleted [[Fish/Legends|fish]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon novel">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>

===Devaronians===
{{Quote|No! No! I am demanding ''Republic'' justice! Not Devaron!|Devaronian [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Vien'sai'Malloc]], about to be fed to the quarra.|<ref name="JAS">''[[Jedi: Aayla Secura]]''</ref>}}
Though [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]] were not generally malevolent, their tradition of severe capital punishment kept them from being accepted into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Criminals found guilty of a capital crime were thrown alive into a nest of ravenous [[quarra]]s, rending her or him to pieces in a public execution.<ref name="NEGAS" />

===Ebruchi===
The [[Ebruchi]] were cruel [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who enjoyed the pain and suffering of others, and showed no kindness unless they gained something in the process. When a lone [[Starship/Legends|starship]] or a small convoy passed through their territory, the Ebruchi would usually just intercept their prey, but when confronted with enigmatic enemies, they used a different method. Pretending to be friendly, the strangers would be invited to meet aboard the Ebruchi command vessel for a feast and an exchange of information. The ambassadors were then seized as hostages, either to wring out an hefty ransom, or torture the prisoners to learn the location of hidden treasure.<ref name="UR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

===Entuurans===
[[File:Mox_Slosin.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Mox Slosin was a entuuran inquisitor infamous for his use of torture.]]
The [[Human/Legends|Humans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Entuur]] valued pain and suffering, which could partially explain the sadistic tendencies of the [[Entuuran]] [[High Inquisitor]] [[Mox Slosin]], one of the Empire's most efficient interrogators. During the years of the rebellion, a report from the [[Task Force on Alliance Security]] described him as perhaps one of the most sadistic and cruelest beings in the Empire's service. In his mind, torture was an art form, almost a game, where the challenge was to traverse the line of the victim's pain and endurance without killing the person. Still, occasionally his enthusiasm would drive him too far, and his subjects died during "overly sensitive" interrogations.<ref name="AIR" />

===Ewoks===
The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] were a good-natured species who valued community, friendship and family.<ref name="NEGAS" /> But although they may look cute, they were cunning, ferocious warriors, and an Ewok tribe wouldn't think twice about cooking its enemy alive over open flames.<ref name="GORW" /> They were also known to eat their enemies' roasted flesh.<ref name="Endor">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref>

===Geonosians===
The bloodthirsty civilization of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] enthusiastically encouraged public executions in gladiatorial arenas, where condemned individuals would die a gruesome death from the sharp teeth of savage beasts, or at the hands of their fellow prisoners. Thousands of Geonosians would congregate in the execution arenas to watch, and the vicious animals were goaded by the [[Static pike/Legends|static pikes]] of picadors.<ref name="NEGAS" />

===Gungans===
[[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] were not tolerant of anyone who threatened their peaceful culture. They had very strict laws, and would go to the extremes to punish anyone who had committed even a minor crime. Vandals were given a sentence of exile or caning, even being stoned to [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="NEGAS" />

===Hutts===
[[File:Jabbas_Palace.jpg|thumb|right|250px|In the dungeons of [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], the enemies of Jabba the Hutt had to die slowly and painfully.]]
Undisputed lords of the underworld, most [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] were vicious megalomaniacs who considered their species to be beyond morality as perceived by lesser beings.<ref name="UAA" /> Combined with the fact that many Hutts were leaders of the vast [[Hutt Empire]]([[Empire (disambiguation)|s]]),<ref name="NEGWT" /> it was hardly surprising that many Hutts enjoyed torturing sentients to gain their own ends.<ref name="Gambit" /> Hutts were the most notorious [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]; most of them took great pleasure in torturing their enemies, and more than a few of them liked to find new "sport" in these activities.<ref name="Scum and Villainy sourcebook">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>

Hutt [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Tassaa Bareesh]] of the [[Bareesh]] Clan had a torture chamber in [[Tassaa Bareesh's palace|her palace]], where unruly [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] were punished.<ref name="The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref>

The notorious Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] enjoyed the cruelty of torture, such as imprisoning victims in a room with bloodsucking worms,<ref name="IWSWT" /> or execution by feeding them to the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]], sacrificing them to the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> having them thrown out the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]],<ref name="Jabba the Hutt: The Hunger of Princess Nampi">''[[Jabba the Hutt: The Hunger of Princess Nampi]]''</ref> or tying them up in [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Valley of the Winds]], where the sand tides would throw the sand deposits and small stones around with such velocity that they would cut into the victim's skin, slashing them to death; this method was known as [[the Teeth of Tatooine]].<ref name="TBH" /> His architect [[Derren Flet/Legends|Derren Flet]] was executed when Flet failed to provide adequate space for the countless dungeons where Jabba's enemies suffered slow, painful deaths.<ref name="DB-Jabba the Hutt's Palace">{{DB|location|jabbathehuttspalace|Jabba the Hutt's Palace}}</ref>

Another feared Hutt crime lord was [[Rokko]] the Hutt, notorious for being one of the most vengeful gangsters of Coruscant's underworld. His invention and enjoyment of various forms of torture was the stuff of many a con beings's nightmare.<ref name="JT" /> The gangster [[Durga Besadii Tai|Durga]] the Hutt was also fond of using torture as a tool. When he learned that his parent, [[Aruk Besadii Aora|Aruk]], had been poisoned to death, Durga's entire household staff was rigorously interrogated. Durga oversaw each session personally, and at least six members died.<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref> Other Hutt gangsters using torture as a means to an end were [[Grappa (Hutt)|Grappa]],<ref name="CE2">''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood]]''</ref> [[Zonnos Anjiliac Priare|Zonnos]],<ref name="TF">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref> [[Riboga]],<ref name="LFCG" /> and [[Bogga]].<ref name="Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Ulic Qel-Droma and the Beast Wars of Onderon">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Ulic Qel-Droma and the Beast Wars of Onderon]]''</ref>

===Nightsisters of Dathomir===
The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] prided themselves in ruthlessness and barbarism, and a propensity for violence and cruelty was drilled into their early training. A Nightsister was encouraged to impose her will on those weaker and constantly test her power, and would earn the respect of her fellow sisters by being at least as powerful as them, or, even better, making them fear her by being twice as ruthless. The ones who failed to learn ruthlessness were cast out, or, more commonly, would not survive. According to the Dathomiri Nightsisters, the weak were meant to serve.<ref name="DSS" />

The dark side Force witches would gladly torture their slaves or prisoners to punish them or keep them in line. The same thing went for the weak ones.<ref name="IE2" /> Occasionally Nightsisters painfully executed individuals, if for no other reason than it suited their desires at the time. One method was to inject the victim,<ref name="IE3" /> or force them to drink a liquid containing [[artery worm]]s. The worms would burrow through the victim's veins<ref name="IE2" /> and feed on their arteries. A Nightsister would survive the treatment after a day of torment; others would not, unless they were given a special potion containing witch blood, which would rid the victim of the worms, provided the worms hadn't reached their heart.<ref name="IE3" />

===Mandalorians===
{{Quote|Your tunic could do with a wash."''<br />''"It's the little horns. You can't punch a Nikto. Had to use something else.|Mandalorians Kal Skirata and Walon Vau|<ref name="RC:TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Kal_Skirata.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The Mandalorian mercenary and assassin Kal Skirata was a proponent of torture, both as an interrogation method and as a training method for resisting interrogation.]]
The life of the Mandalorians revolved around battle and war, both as a culture and as a source of pride and honor. Often working as [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], Mandalorians were proven to be ruthless adversaries, known for their tough pragmatism and brutality. In battle, they would do whatever was necessary to reach their objective.<ref name="The Mandalorians: People and Culture">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref> While it is unknown exactly how common the use of torture was among these feared warriors, at least some Mandalorians had no qualms about implementing torture as a means to an end. Notable examples were the mercenary and assassin [[Kal Skirata]] and mercenary [[Walon Vau]].<ref name="TZ" /> Apparently, the bounty hunter [[Rav Bralor]] shared their attitudes; after the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloner]] [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]] was captured by Skirata during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Bralor casually asked him what information he was going to beat out of Sai.<ref name="RC:TC" /> The [[Mandallian Giant]] [[Feskitt Bobb]] employed a special torture method called the Burning, to apprehend his quarries.<ref name="I80" /> The [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Darman Skirata|RC-1136]] ("Darman"), who was trained by Kal Skirata, went as far as saying that torture had to be done, and did not make you a bad person.<ref name="TZ" />

Right after the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], the Mandalorian [[Silas (Mandalorian)|Silas]] was tortured by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] for information on [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. As a Mandalorian, Silas was trained to withstand torture, but Dooku's methods were too much for him to endure. After telling everything the Count wanted to know, he was killed through an ultra-lethal injection.<ref name="OS2" />

===Skrillings===
[[Skrilling/Legends|Skrillings]] devoured uncooked, spoiled meat, that would have made others deathly ill. As a result, they often lived near the torture chambers of unscrupulous despots, or anywhere else where a steady supply of corpses and other carrion could be found.<ref name="UAA" />

===Tal Nami===
The [[Tal Nami (species)|Tal Nami]] had an intense dislike of villainous traders, and any dealer who was caught trading unfairly was punished by having their feet tied to the roots of an [[egoa tree]], and their arms tied to the branches of the tree, a tree which grew at a rate of one meter a day. The Tal Nami would even travel light-years to track down a villainous trader.<ref name="City">''[[Galaxy of Fear: City of the Dead]]''</ref>

===Tofs===
The [[Tof/Legends|Tofs]] were hedonistic warriors who would wage war and wreck entire civilizations just for the sake of their amusement. Vandalism and torture was part of this lifestyle.<ref name="UR" />

===Tusken Raider lifestyle===
{{Quote|They are masters of torture!|[[Sharad Hett]]|<ref name="Outlander5">[[Star Wars (1998) 11|''Star Wars'' (1998) 11]]</ref>}}
Adolescent [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] had to undergo ritual blood rites, in which they were obligated to capture and torture a lifeform for weeks before ascending to adulthood. The Tusken emerged more esteemed if the victim was sentient.<ref name="CP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref>

===Vagaari===
The [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] were feared throughout the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. They had a near-total lack of empathy, and the [[Vagaari Empire]] thrived on cruelty and terror. [[Gender/Legends|Males]] and [[Gender/Legends|females]] had separate roles within their society, and Vagaari females made up the castes responsible for torture.<ref name="UR" />

===Yuuzhan Vong===
{{Quote|To understand us, there is one place to start. Let me introduce you to the Embrace of Pain.|Shedao Shai|<ref name="DT2:R">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref>}}
[[File:HettShapers-Legacy2006-18.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A'Sharad Hett is subjected to the torments of Yuuzhan Vong shapers.]]
The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] glorified pain as a motive for action and as a state of living. The Vong [[warrior caste]] derived perverse pleasure from their own pain and from the pain of others.<ref name="NEGAS" />

When Jedi Knight A'Sharad Hett was captured by Yuuzhan Vong scouts, they imprisoned him and placed him in their Embrace of Pain. Hett was relentlessly tortured and subjected to biological experiments, [[Organ grafting|replacing]] both his cybernetic eye and arm with biological Yuuzhan Vong components.<ref name="Legacy18">[[Legacy (2006) 18|''Legacy'' (2006) 18]]</ref>

During the first stages of the Yuuzhan Vong invasion, Jedi Knight [[Miko Reglia]] was captured at [[Helska IV]]. There, he was introduced to a [[yammosk]] and subjected to "mind-[[breaking]]," where the Vong would feign his execution by drawing him in to within centimeters of the [[yammosk]]'s voracious teeth, over and over again. Each pseudo-execution replayed in his mind nearly as vivid as the actual act.<ref name="VP" />

In the midst of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the Yuuzhan Vong [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Shedao Shai]] made use of the Embrace of Pain to inflict pain on himself and others, including [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Elegos A'Kla]].<ref name="DTI" />

When Jedi Knight [[Tahiri Veila]] was captured by the Vong, she was subjected to a painful [[Shaping protocol|shaping]] project by the [[Master Shaper]] [[Mezhan Kwaad]] and her assistant [[Nen Yim]], who attempted to make Tahiri closer to the Yuuzhan Vong, creating a ''new'' personality for her: that of Riina Kwaad.<ref name="EVI" />

Later in the war, several Jedi were assigned to destroy the [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facility at [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]], including [[Anakin Solo|Anakin]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]], Tahiri Veila, and [[Zekk]]. The Jedi were captured and tortured, and one of them, [[Ulaha Kore]], almost died. The Yuuzhan Vong commander [[Duman Yaght]] showed particular sadism against the Jedi by repeatedly inflicting pain upon the already injured Ulaha, and by forcing Jaina Solo to choose which of her brothers was to be tortured.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Star by Star">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>

===Zanibar===
The frightening [[Zanibar]] used live subjects for their ceremonies, ritual sacrifices that no victim ever returned from. Judging from what [[Kir Kanos]] saw when traveling to [[Xo]] to rescue [[Mirith Sinn]], the hapless prisoner was restrained and kept hanging upside down, before being carved up with sharp axes and spiky sickles.<ref name="CE2" />

==Regimes and organizations==
{{Quote|Tell me, Hosk Trey'lis&mdash;tell me what you know of the one named Cade.''"<br />"''I'll&hellip; tell&hellip; you&hellip; nothing!''"<br />"''We both know that's not true, Trey'lis.|Hosk Trey'lis, being interrogated by Darth Maladi, head of Sith Intelligence and Assassination.|<ref name="Legacy9" />}}
===The Absolutes===
During the reign of [[Absolutes|The Absolutes]], the dissidents of [[New Apsolon/Legends|New Apsolon]] were imprisoned and subjected to "reclassification," which was the government's term for torture. Prisoners were often kept waiting without food or water for long periods to break down their resistance, before being "reclassified." Separate rooms were designed for different forms of torture. One chamber had screens where the prisoners had to watch other victims being tortured, sometimes their own friends or family.<ref name="TTTB" />

===Corporate Sector Authority===
The Corporate Sector Authority often resorted to torture and intimidation to coerce unwilling prisoners into revealing information. They had many of the same tools as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at their disposal, like [[energy prod]]s, interrogation and truth drugs, [[Agonizer-6 nerve disruptor|nerve disruptors]] and [[Interrogation droid/Legends|torture droids]].<ref name="EGWT" /> The Authority's penal colony was [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]], a facility located on [[Mytus VII/Legends|Mytus VII]],<ref name="End" /> where in the main tower, the doomed prisoners were confined in stasis booths until removed for interrogation or execution.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> The interrogation facilities were located in the top levels of the tower. Over time, Stars' End developed a reputation in some Imperial circles for effectiveness in its interrogation techniques.<ref name="RECC">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

When the [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]] colony [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="End" /> [[Fibuli]]<ref name="HSCSS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> was annexed by the Authority, some Trianii tried armed resistance. The ones captured by the invaders were brutally interrogated by the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Police ("[[Security Police/Legends|Espos]]"), who were seeking their ringleaders. One of the methods used was [[The Burning/Legends|The Burning]]. Among those who were captured and put in Authority custody was [[Atuarre]]'s mate, the resistance fighter [[Keeheen]], and their son [[Pakka]]. The Authority was no respecter of age and convention, and used methods of interrogation on Pakka, which had left the cub unable to speak when his mother finally managed to rescue him.<ref name="End" /> Keeheen was subjected to countless torture sessions, but refused to help the Authority with the subjugation of his people,<ref name="HSCSS" /> and was sent to Stars' End,<ref name="End" /> where his life consisted only of countless interrogations and cycles of dreamless sleep in a stasis booth.<ref name="HSCSS" /> He was eventually rescued, and reunited with his wife and son.<ref name="End" /> Pakka began to speak a few week after the family's return to their homeworld [[Trian/Legends|Trian]]. His speech was rare and halting, but he was beginning to get over his trauma.<ref name="HSCSS" />

===Doan Royal House===
Many centuries before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|battle of Yavin]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]] was ruled by the [[Doan Royal House]]. A vast dungeon complex, called the [[Stone Prison]], was built into the rock several kilometers below [[Royal Manse|their castle]], and was used to make political opponents vanish. The prisoners were shielded from detection by [[scanner]]s, and could disappear forever, spending the rest of their life in shackles, tortured for information or sadistic pleasure.<ref name="DBDE" />

In response to public pressure from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the Stone Prison was eventually closed down. More than forty years later, in [[980 BBY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Serra]] used the prison's facilities to torture the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], believing him to be the one who killed [[Caleb|her father]].<ref name="DBDE" />

===Galactic Alliance Guard===
[[File:JacenCaedus.jpg|thumb|right|190px|Darth Caedus, leader of the Galactic Alliance Guard.]]
The [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] (GAG) was formed in the wake of growing protests and violent terrorist groups opposing the increasingly dictatorial methods of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. The new, secret police force was a covert branch of the [[Galactic Alliance Intelligence Service]], and was tasked with finding and eliminating those who threatened galactic peace and order. In the beginning, this was meant to be the terrorists, whose attacks were mostly coordinated from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Later, the GAG would expand its mandate to target anyone their leader, Darth Caedus, viewed as a threat to galactic peace and his own power.<ref name="GOI" />

The organization would soon become feared across the entire [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Caedus gave those under his command leave to use any method necessary to identify the enemies of the Galactic Alliance and force them to reveal their comrades. Not only would a suspect be subjected to torture, but to gain even more information, her or his entire family would be arrested and made to watch. Even expressing a negative opinion about the Galactic Alliance was enough to be tortured. Caedus himself personally conducted the most vicious interrogations. The GAG was formally disbanded after the defeat of Caedus.<ref name="GOI" />

===Galactic Empire===
{{Quote|You will be interrogated. Tortured. You ''will'' give me the names of your friends and allies. And then you will die."''<br />''"Our deaths will only rally others."''<br />''"Your very public and painful executions will serve as an example to the rest of the galaxy.|Emperor Palpatine addressing his captives, [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] and [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]]|audio=InterrogatedTortured-TFU.flac|<ref name="TFUvg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>}}
During the reign of the Galactic Empire, torture was elevated to an art form.<ref name="IT-O NEGD" /> The Imperial regime had many tools at its disposal, like [[energy prod]]s, interrogation and truth drugs, [[Agonizer-6 nerve disruptor|nerve disruptors]],<ref name="EGWT" /> racks<ref name="JASB">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref> and [[Interrogation droid/Legends|torture droids]].<ref>''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]'' and ''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

According to rumors, Emperor Palpatine himself kept private detention centers in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] lower levels, with [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O]] torture droids to tear information from the reluctant. When [[Pollux Hax/Legends|Pollux Hax]], chief of the Emperor's propaganda dissemination section, wrote an article about the wonders of Imperial Center (a report commissioned by Palpatine himself), he claimed that the Emperor had no need for such "barbaric practices," and had "no need to keep secrets."<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> In reality, there existed several secret torture chambers close to the solid surface of the planet, disguised as nondescript, run-down buildings.<ref name="EGWT" />

The Emperor himself viewed torture as a useful tool; after the Empire's ultimate weapon (the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]) was destroyed, Palpatine summoned the chief engineer, [[Bevel Lemelisk]], to meet with him personally. There, Lemelisk was locked in a cage and eaten alive by hungry piranha beetles as the Emperor blamed him for the weapon's design flaw. After finally succumbing to what he thought was his death, Lemelisk awoke the next day in a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] body, with all memories intact. Palpatine told him that though his talents were quite useful, failure of any sort was intolerable. All in all, he would be executed seven times, every execution just as painful, from being lowered inch by inch into a vat of molten [[Copper/Legends|copper]] (which Palpatine told Lemelisk was what the smelter preferred that day), being flushed out of an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] and crushed by hard [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]], to being sealed in a room where acid mist gored and dissolved his flesh.<ref name="Darksaber" />

[[File:Cruelty-GH.png_|thumb|left|250px|Imperial officers interrogating a prisoner.]]
Torture wasn't exclusive to Palpatine or Imperial umbrella organizations; many Imperial officers also utilized the painful art form. Notable examples were [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]],<ref name="JS" /> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bentilais san Sk'ar|Sk'ar]],<ref name="Star Wars 1977 54">[[Star Wars (1977) 54|''Star Wars'' (1977) 54]]</ref> [[Captain-Supervisor]] [[Grammel]] and [[Leonia Tavira]].<ref name="SOTME" /> Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Danetta Pitta|Pitta]] was a zealous anti-alien bigot and defender of [[High Human Culture/Legends|Human High Culture]]. His three Imperial [[Prison ship/Legends|dungeon ships]]&mdash;the ''[[Apocahk]]'', the ''[[Angrix]]'' and the ''[[Azgoghk]]''&mdash;searched the Outer Rim territories, depopulating alien homeworlds and dooming the hapless inhabitants to [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] and vivisection.<ref name="Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}}</ref> The chief scientist [[Leonis Murthé]] aboard the ''Azgoghk'' used the alien prisoners for his personal studies, experimenting with new ways to kill and investigating how long he could make a being scream.<ref name="BFAD" />

Several people joined or defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] after witnessing how the Empire treated its prisoners. One notable example was [[Zevulon Veers]], member of the Empire's [[Sub-Adult Group/Legends|Sub-Adult Group]] battalion and son of Imperial soldier [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]]. When Zevulon's commanding officer, [[Ivo Laibach]], tortured an elderly man suspected of supporting the Alliance, he helped the man escape and defected to the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Dark Empire Sourcebook">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> Another example was the medic [[Ahleazah]], who did her best to relieve the pain and suffering of her fellow beings after being forced into the Empire's medical corps. Eventually, she managed to escape, and served the Alliance as a medic and healer.<ref name="Heroes & Rogues">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>

====ISB====
[[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] (the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order) was a vast and influential umbrella organization,<ref name="RECC" /> designed to maintain support for Emperor Palpatine's [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]<ref name="IS">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> and to indoctrinate the youth of the Empire. An important part of its structure was [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] (Imperial Security Bureau), the Empire's law-enforcement division, which provided protection for the Imperial populace - in the form of surveillance, investigation, interrogation and reeducation.<ref name="RECC" /> As an organization created to increase the Emperor's knowledge of political events, one of ISB's tasks was to uncover beings or activities that might obstruct Palpatine's plans. The people caught who were suspected of withholding information were sent to Interrogation, one of ISB's branches. Apparently, few people really knew what happened to the suspects, since no one really wanted to know.<ref name="IS" /> "Facilitation" was an [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] euphemism for torture.<ref name="RERSFH" />

The former [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Dav Kathis]] experienced firsthand that use of torture wasn't utilized only by COMPNOR's ISB subdivision. Kathis was kidnapped by a group of COMPNOR thugs who erroneously believed he was supplying information to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and when the group finally realized that they'd caught the wrong person, Kathis was nearly dying from the torture and interrogation sessions.<ref name="Stock Ships">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>

====Imperial Intelligence====
[[File:Isard.jpg|thumb|right|190px|Ysanne Isard, director of Imperial Intelligence]]
A rival to ISB, [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] had its own branch of Interrogation, and Rebels or other enemy agents caught by the organization were usually sent to Interrogation<ref name="IS" /> to undergo thorough questioning, using drugs, psychology and mental and physical torture.<ref name="RECC" /> Imperial Intelligence (Intel) had many sophisticated torture devices at its disposal, including pain tables, nerve inductors, sensory deprivation chambers, sensory overload chambers, selective neurotoxins, truth drugs and [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O]] torture [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> However, Imperial Intelligence members were not so fanatically dedicated to the New Order as their counterparts in ISB,<ref name="UnCam" /> and Interrogation was said to be somewhat less bloodthirsty than ISB and therefore slightly less effective in breaking a Rebel's will. Unless the Rebel suspect was believed to hold vital information, interrogation would be light compared to what it could have been, but many of the prisoners would be subjected to brainwashing through neuroprogramming and image surgery.<ref name="IS" /> Subconscious instructions and posthypnotic commands could be programmed into a prisoner's subconscious through the use of hypno-imprinting and hypno-indoctrination. The technique was used on many captured Rebel agents, who were then released, and found their way back to the hidden Rebel bases. The hypno-imprinting forced these Rebels to spy for the Empire without knowing that they were betraying the Rebel Alliance. A suicide command could be implanted into the Rebel's mind, activating if the brainwashing was discovered by their fellow Rebels.<ref name="EGWT" />

When the Rebel mathematician [[Jorin Sol]] was betrayed by the [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiimi]] resistance fighter [[Tal Hesz]], he was taken into Imperial custody, and tortured personally by Darth Vader.<ref name="Empire 34">[[Empire 34|''Empire'' 34]]</ref> After giving Vader the logarithms used for rendezvous points of the Rebel fleet, he was taken to the Imperial base on [[Kalist VI/Legends|Kalist VI]], and tortured by the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Zuud]].<ref name="WSW" /> When Jorin was finally rescued, he had been brainwashed and given a special mission: "Destroy the Rebellion from the inside."<ref name="MBME">''[[Star Wars: Rebellion: My Brother, My Enemy]]''</ref>

The [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]], [[Ysanne Isard]], was known for her masterful interrogation skills and was able to extract full and true confessions out of most subjects before day's end.<ref name="GOI" />

====The Inquisitorius====
{{Quote|And now, my Rebel friend, we shall have a&hellip; chat.|Antinnis Tremayne|<ref name="GG9" />}}
The [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] was a secret division of Imperial Intelligence, consisting of [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-trained agents<ref name="RES">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref> called [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Imperial Inquisitors]].<ref name="DSS" /> These agents performed various tasks for Intelligence, including surveillance missions and intelligence-gathering, but were most often called upon to assist with interrogation of prisoners;<ref name="RES" /> though Force-sensitive, many Inquisitors learned only basic Force powers suited for interrogation.<ref name="UnCam" /> Intelligence would rarely call upon the Inquisitorius,<ref name="DSS" /> but did so when all other methods of interrogation failed, including drugs and torture. With their potent Force-skills and powerful techniques of manipulation, Imperial Inquisitors rarely failed to break the victim's will.<ref name="RES" /> They were ruthless and effective even when not using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], and few could withstand an interrogation session with an Imperial Inquisitor.<ref name="UnCam" />

The agents were also charged with seeking out other Force-users, either turning them to the will of the Emperor, or eliminating them.<ref name="DSS" /> They specialized in scouring the Galaxy for all types of Force-sensitives, from surviving Jedi to adepts to primitive shamans, and every student of the Force not aligned with the Emperor.<ref name="UnCam" /> Inquisitors were enlisted by the Emperor himself to destroy the last remnants of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and would seek out, track down and capture Jedi who escaped the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. The captured Jedi were faced with an ultimatum&mdash;usually along with torture&mdash;to turn to the dark side and join Palpatine's New Order, or be destroyed. The Inquisitors were known for their ruthlessness, and could torture an entire village of innocents to draw one Jedi into a trap. The best Inquisitors had everything from [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to money at their disposal, including sophisticated torture instruments.<ref name="DSS" />

[[File:Tremayne_MTSESB.jpg|thumb|left|230px|High Inquisitor Tremayne]]
The [[Citadel Inquisitorius]] was the central base of operations for much of the Inquisitorius. The citadel was a towering black spire jutting from a position nestled in the mountains of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]]. There, the [[High Inquisitor]]s were given assignments and came to confer with others of their order. Housed within the spire were a number of torture chambers and detention blocks used to detain and torture the most dangerous and strong-willed prisoners. Many citizens on Prakith whispered that the screams of the Jedi brought to the citadel echoed across the mountains for days at a time.<ref name="Byss and the Deep Core, Part 3: Prakith">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050421planet3|series=Byss and the Deep Core|text=Part 3: Prakith}}</ref>

[[High Inquisitor]] [[Antinnis Tremayne]] was a former Jedi Knight who was seduced by the dark side.<ref name="DSS" /> The most feared and respected High Inquisitor in the Outer Rim, he was a master of manipulation and his interrogation skills were formidable.<ref name="GG9" /> He was disarmingly polite and composed, unnerving his subjects. He believed the victim, as an intelligent subject, could be convinced that they were better off to confess, rather than stubbornly resisting to the point where torture was necessary. Cordial and friendly, he wanted his victims to know how much he regretted that fate had brought them together like this, and often took some time explaining that when two ideologies intersected, one must give way, and it would not be Tremayne's.<ref name="DSS" /> Quiet and calm, he reassured his victims that they ''would'' break. Often, his mere presence was enough to break the will of those who had resisted all other approaches. He had failed to break only one victim; the Jedi [[Corwin Shelvay/Legends|Corwin Shelvay]]. After losing a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] duel with Shelvay, he chose metal cybernetics for his damaged face and arm, to enhance the fear in those he interrogated.<ref name="GG9" />

Another notable Inquisitor was [[Loam Redge]], who derived great pleasure and joy from his work, and finding, torturing and destroying Force-sensitives was his highest priority. He was good at his vocation, and when he was at his busiest, he looked as though he was enjoying a private joke.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]''</ref>

[[Stratagems of the Inquisitorius]] was a book on torture and interrogation, used by the Inquisitorius.<ref name="NEGD" />

====Department of Punishment====
Also around 0 BBY, the Galactic Empire commissioned the [[Department of Punishment]], a government agency dedicated to the relentless torture of detained Rebels and Imperial criminals. The department was run by the infamous [[Master Torturer]] [[Vengnar Heiff]], who rather than use devices to torment his captives, used his massive reptilian claws to brutally slash and gore them. The very nature of Heiff's methods garnered him the nickname ''the butcher'', and the majority of his peers sought to remain in good standing with him because of it. The screams could be heard throughout the Ithorian herdship ''[[Tafanda Bay]]'' as the Master Torturer tore apart his helpless victims.<ref name="Star Wars Missions 7: Ithorian Invasion">''[[Star Wars Missions 7: Ithorian Invasion]]''</ref>

====School of Torturers====
Yet another testament to the Empire's tradition of extracting information the painful way was the [[School of Torturers]], a training facility on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Children of the Jedi novel">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>

===The Krath===
Four millennia before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Keto]] was the ruler of the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]], sharing the power with the [[Carbonite Guild]]. Both were arrogant and ruthless, and Keto kept dissidents in line with the regular use of [[Interrogation droid/Legends|torture droids]]. When Aleema and her cousin came to power after the coup in [[3996 BBY]], they kept the tradition of using torture droids going, to crush any resistance from those who were unwilling to accept them as their rulers. The [[Sith sorcerer|Sith sorceress]] [[Keto|Aleema]] also liked to feed dissenters to her [[Aleema Keto's pet|pet]], a serpentine constrictor with quills that wrapped itself around the victim.<ref name="TJDLS" />

===The Lost Ones===
The [[Lost Ones]] were a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] street gang who were at one point led by the [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Trunks Bibo]]. One of the few things in life that Bibo took pleasure in was torturing new gang members, and the Lost Ones' gartro rookery ritual, devised by Bibo himself, was notorious in Coruscant's underworld for its needless cruelty.<ref name="CCW" />

===Sith===
Many members of the order of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] utilized torture as a tool; notable examples included Darth Malak,<ref name="KOTOR" /> [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]],<ref name="DBRT" /> Darth Sidious<ref name="Lawless" /><ref name="ROTJ" /><ref name="Darksaber" /> and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] Darth Vader,<ref name="R78" /><ref name="ReferenceA" /><ref name="P">[[Purge (comic book)|''Purge'']]</ref> [[Vergere]],<ref name="Bloodlines" /><ref name="T" /> [[Darth Caedus]]<ref name="Bloodlines" /> and his apprentice [[Tahiri Veila]],<ref name="Invincible" /> [[Darth Krayt]],<ref name="Legacy18" /> [[Darth Maladi]]<ref name="L0" /> and [[Darth Havok]].<ref name="L49" /> Sith were also known for torturing [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with physical agony to try and corrupt captive Jedi to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="Old">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

====Sith Intelligence and Assassination====
[[File:MaladiTorturesHosk-Leg9.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darth Maladi torturing Hosk Trey'lis]]
During the reign of Darth Krayt, the agency in charge of torture was [[Sith Intelligence and Assassination]]. The [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Maladi presided over this "branch of government," and was herself an expert in the ways of torture.<ref name="L0" />

One of her victims was the [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healer]] [[Hosk Trey'lis]], who was interrogated by Maladi in [[Darth Maladi's laboratory|her laboratory]], and was made to reveal the identity of [[Cade Skywalker]]. Lady Maladi used [[PI-series medical assistant droid|torture droids]] to implement brutal punishments on the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] Jedi until she finally gleaned from him Skywalker's name.<ref name="Legacy9">[[Legacy (2006) 9|''Legacy'' (2006) 9]]</ref>

====Sith training====
The life of a Sith apprentice, one aspiring to attain the rank of Sith Lord, was laden with mental and physical torture. This relentless "training" was designed to mold the apprentice into an individual who was strong, calculating, and determined.<ref name="DSS" />

In [[3956 BBY]], the Jedi Bastila Shan was captured by Darth Malak. In order to force her into accepting the dark side, he relentlessly tortured her for a week through the use of Force lightning. She eventually fell to the dark side and became his apprentice, although she was later eased back to the light side by a redeemed Revan.<ref name="KOTOR" />

During the tenure of Lord [[Skere Kaan]]'s Sith [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]], the students of the Sith [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] were subjected to rigorous training exercises that many of them felt were along the lines of torture. The practice of covering the students' [[Sith training saber|training sabers]] with microscopic [[Pelko bug]] barbs, was implemented in lightsaber training exercises. The barbs secreted a venom which when introduced to an individual's bloodstream, caused numbness and severe pain, similar to the feeling an actual lightsaber strike induced. Students were to practice their combat techniques daily, and many sessions often ended with students severely injured, as though they had participated in actual combat.<ref name="POD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>

After [[Galen Marek]] became Darth Vader's secret apprentice, his new master spent years personally training Starkiller (the codename Galen now went by), in the ways of the Sith. Starkiller's training was harsh and unforgiving: Vader subjected the boy to rigorous physical tests bordering on torture.<ref name="DB-Starkiller Darth Vader's Secret Apprentice">{{DB|character|starkiller|Starkiller (Darth Vader's Secret Apprentice)}}</ref>

After Jacen Solo was captured by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]],<ref name="T" /> [[Vergere]], who years later was revealed to be one of the Sith,<ref name="F">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref> held him trapped in the [[Embrace of Pain]]<ref name="T" /> for weeks,<ref name="DW">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref> forcing him to give into the pain and understand the strength gained from it when it was fully embraced.<ref name="T" />

The Embrace of Pain was used again by the Sith Lord Darth Caedus, who in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] used it to torture his own cousin, Ben Skywalker aboard the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']]. Hoping to forge Ben into a Sith apprentice, Caedus took Ben to the lower levels of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], where he secretly had his own personal Embrace of Pain installed. Ben was subjected to Vong biotoxins injected via organic needles that caused immense pain and swelling. Ben was subsequently rescued by his father, Master Luke Skywalker, but his recovery was painstaking; the injections continued to cause him agony, and swelling from his wounds took weeks to heal.<ref name="I" />

[[Dread Lord]] Darth Krayt had previously experienced the Embrace of Pain after completing his apprenticeship with [[XoXaan]] on Korriban and being captured by the Yuuzhan Vong. As Dark Lord of the Sith, Krayt would use the Embrace as part of the training for certain members of the [[One Sith|new Sith Order]], including [[Darth Nihl]], in order to push them towards the dark side. One of Nihl's ordeals in the Embrace was so painful that it drove him to slaughter an entire village. Krayt would also have the Embrace of Pain installed in the underlevels of the [[Temple of the Sith]].<ref name="Legacy18" />

===The Tundei===
During the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the nominal government of [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] was usurped by the [[Tundei]] regime. After a relative golden age of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] and [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]], the new regime of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was extreme in their persecution of lawbreakers, and would torture those who were even ''suspected'' of armed violence or trafficking contraband. Political dissidents also became victims of torture.<ref name="CCW" />

==Torture in the name of science==
[[File:LeonisMurthe-BFAOD.jpg|thumb|right|230px|[[Leonis Murthé]] "experimenting" on a [[Gulmarid]]]]
{{Quote|I have never understood discrimination against other species; in fact, it is the comparative differences that make beings so interesting to study.
